abilities.menuDescription: Based on the chosen Eternal Category, empower Ikras abilities. Harbingers: Ikra's Fathom deals +(10%) as magical damage. Hitting an Enemy with Fathom reduces the cooldown of Brine by 0.5s. Primarchs: Popping Hydroclasm now displaces Ikra. Gain 1% Movement Speed per 75 magical power. Dreadnoughts: Narcosis' Suspension duration is increased by 25% and restores 100% Health of the Hero Damage dealt by it. Sovereigns: Hydroclasm has 25% reduced Cooldown and Genesis is 25% larger. Divines: Hydroclasm's Bubbles project an aura that heals Ikra and Allied Heroes for 5/8/11/14/17/8/11/14/17 (+12%) Health every second. Anomalies: Brine and Hydroclasm deal 3% of the Target’s Maximum Health over 4s and apply 45% Anti Heal for the same duration.
abilities.name: Herald

abilities.desc: Release a unit piercing Water Sphere that floats towards Enemies dealing Damage and stopping on the first Enemy Hero hit, Suspending them.
abilities.gameDescription: Release a floating Water Sphere. • Deals {Damage}()Damage to Enemies it passes through. • Stops on first Enemy Hero hit. • Suspends Enemy Hero for {Duration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Ikra unleashes a Water Sphere dealing 85/115/145/175/205 (+50%) magical damage. The Sphere pierces through Enemy Units but stops on hitting an Enemy Hero, surrounding and Suspending them for 1.1s.
abilities.name: Narcosis

abilities.desc: Create an Abyssal Bubble at a targeted location. If the Bubble is hit by Brine or your Basic Attack, it pops, dealing damage and refunding mana. The Bubble will amplify after a short duration, dealing increased damage and slowing.
abilities.gameDescription: Create an Abyssal Bubble that amplifies after {Delay}s. • Hitting a Bubble with Fathom or Brine Pops it, dealing {Damage}()Damage. • Amplified Bubbles deal {AmpDamage}()Damage and Slow by {Slow}% for {SlowDuration}s. • Popping Bubbles with Brine adds it's Damage additionally • Amplified Bubbles popped by Brine ignore {AmpPen}% Magical Armor. • Restore {ManaRefund} Mana whenever a Bubble is Popped. • Enemies within a Bubble's radius are Slowed by {RadiusSlow}%. • Max Charges: {Charges}
abilities.menuDescription: Ikra creates an Abyssal Bubble that Slows Enemies by 20% while they are in its radius. The Bubble can be popped by hitting it with either Fathom or Brine, dealing 35/45/55/65/75 (+15%) magical damage to all Targets in a 520 Unit radius and restoring 30 Mana. The Bubble amplifies after 1.1s, increasing the damage dealt to 75/120/165/210/255 (+80%) magical damage whilst Slowing all Targets hit by 40/45/50/55/60% for 1s. Popping a Bubble with Brine deals Brine's Damage as well as Hydroclasm's Damage. If the Bubble is amplified when popped by Brine, the total damage penetrates 40% of the Target's Magical Armor. Max Charges: 2
abilities.name: Hydroclasm

abilities.desc: Rise high into the sky and unleash a disruptive Waterspout that pierces walls. When the Waterspout hits an Enemy, they will be knocked up and slowed upon landing.
abilities.gameDescription: Channel the tides before releasing a surging Waterspout. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Knocks Up Enemies hit. • After Enemies land, they are Slowed by {Slow}% for {SlowDuration}s. • The Waterspout pierces walls.
abilities.menuDescription: Ikra rises into the sky for 1s and channels the tides before unleashing a surging Waterspout from his Trident that pierces Walls. The Waterspout deals 320/460/600 (+85%) magical damage and Knocks Up Enemies hit. When Enemy Targets land from the Knock Up, they are Slowed by 40% for 1.25s.
abilities.name: Genesis

abilities.desc: Throw a dagger, dealing damage slowing enemies. Max Charges: 2.
abilities.gameDescription: Throw a razor sharp dagger. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Slows by {Slow}% for {SlowDuration}s. • Non-Heroes receive {MonsterDamage} additional Damage. • Holds up to 2 Daggers.
abilities.menuDescription: Throw a dagger, dealing 60/90/120/150/180 (+85%) physical damage and applying a 25% Slow for 0.75s. Minions and Monsters receive 130 additional damage. Max Charges: 2.
abilities.name: Crippling Dagger

abilities.desc: Unleash razor sharp attacks with your ultralight Plasteel Swords.
abilities.gameDescription: Melee Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.name: Plasteel Swords

abilities.desc: Damaging enemies reveals them and deals damage after a delay. Additionally, Kallari can jump multiple times.
abilities.gameDescription:
• Kallari can Jump up to 2 more times while mid-air.
Upon damaging an Enemy Unit. • Apply Death Mark, Revealing the Target for {DebuffDuration}s. • After {DebuffDuration}s, Death Mark detonates. • Deals {Damage} plus {PercentBonus}()% Missing Health Damage.
abilities.menuDescription: Dealing damage to an Enemy Target applies Death Mark, revealing them for 3.5s. After the duration, the Mark detonates, dealing 15 (+5 per level)(+7 (+2%)% of Target's missing health) true damage. Death Mark cannot be re-applied to a previous Target for 10s. Additionally, Kallari can periodically jump up to 2 additional times.
abilities.name: Death Mark

abilities.desc: Gain Health Regeneration out of vision. Activate to enter Camouflage and gain movement speed.
abilities.gameDescription: After 1.5s, enter Camouflage for {Duration}s. • Gain {DecayingMovementSpeed}% Decaying Movement Speed. • Nearby Heroes and Wards reveal you. • Attacking ends Camouflage instantly. Passive: Gain {HealthRegen}() Health Regen when Out of Vision.
abilities.menuDescription: After 1.5s, enter Camouflage, gaining 40% decaying movement speed for 6s. While in this state, nearby Enemy Heroes and Wards reveal Kallari. Attacking ends Camouflage instantly. Passive: Gain 2 (+75%) Health Regeneration when Out of Vision.
abilities.name: Shadow Walk

abilities.desc: Backflip into the sky, allowing you to dash at a target enemy and deal damage, increasing if they're affected by Death Mark.
abilities.gameDescription: Backflip into the sky: • Target an Enemy to Dash to them. • Deal {Damage}()Damage. • Death Marked Targets take {DamageMultiplier}x more Damage.
abilities.menuDescription: Kallari backflips into the sky. After a short duration, she may target an Enemy to dash towards them, dealing 35/55/75/95/115 (+45%) physical damage. Deals 2x damage if the Target is affected by Death Mark.
abilities.name: Shadow Dance

abilities.desc: Dash forward, cutting through all Enemies in your path, dealing massive damage.
abilities.gameDescription: Dash forward, cutting through all Enemies. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Deals up to {DamageMultiplier}x Damage based on Missing Health.
abilities.menuDescription: After a brief delay Kallari dashes forward, cutting through all Enemies in her path, dealing 120/250/380 (+65/75/85%) physical damage. Deals up to 2.5x damage based on the Target's missing health.
abilities.name: Guillotine

abilities.desc: Leap to an enemy dealing damage and slowing them.
abilities.gameDescription: Leap to an Enemy Hero or Monster. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Deals up to 2x Damage based on Missing Health. • Slows by {Percent}% for {Duration}s. • Grants {StackNum} Rage On-Hit.
abilities.menuDescription: Leap to an Enemy Hero or Monster, dealing 75/105/135/165/195 (+80%) physical damage and Slowing them by 40% for 1.35s. Deals up to 2x damage based on the Target's missing health. Grants 15 Rage on hit.
abilities.name: Ambush

abilities.desc: Brutalize your foes with your primal twin axes, Rage and Spirit.
abilities.gameDescription: Melee Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}. • Grants {StackNum} Rage On-Hit.
abilities.menuDescription: Melee basic attack dealing 63/66.22/69.61/73.18/76.91/80.82/84.91/89.16/93.59/98.19/102.96/107.91/113.02/118.31/123.78/129.41/135.22/141.2 (+85%) physical damage. Grants 4 Rage on hit.
abilities.name: Rage & Spirit

abilities.desc: Dealing damage builds Rage, increasing your Health Regeneration and Cooldown Progression. Maintaining high Rage grants Movement Speed. Go too long without attacking and your Rage decays.
abilities.gameDescription: On damaging Heroes or Monsters: • Build Rage. • Gain {IncreasedRegen}() Health Regeneration per 1 Rage. • Cooldowns progress {CDR}% faster per 1 Rage. • At {StackThreshold} Rage: +{PercentMS}% Movement Speed. • Rage rapidly decays after {Decay}s without attacking.
abilities.menuDescription: Damaging Enemy Heroes or Jungle Monsters grants Khaimera Rage. Khaimera gains 0.1/0.14/0.18/0.2/0.26/0.32/0.38/0.44/0.5/0.56/0.66/0.76/0.86/0.96/1.06/1.22/1.38/1.54-1.5(+0.3%) Health Regeneration (based on Level) and his Cooldowns progress 0.5% faster per 1 Rage. While above 50 Rage, Khaimera gains 8% Movement Speed. Rage decays at a rate of 25 per second after not attacking for 2.5s.
abilities.name: Ancestral Fury

abilities.desc: Gain an incredible amount of attack speed for a short duration allowing you to tear through enemies.
abilities.gameDescription: Unleash your primal spirit for {Duration}s. • Attain maximum Attack Speed for {NumAttacks}() Basic Attack hits. • Each Basic Attack deals {Damage}()Damage. • Applies On-Hit Effects at {OnHitScaling}% effectiveness. • Cleaves nearby Enemies for {AdditionalCleave}% of the Damage.
abilities.menuDescription: Unleash Khaimera's primal spirit for 3s, granting him maximum attack speed for 5 successful attacks. Khaimera gains an additional attack for every 30 Magical Power owned. Each basic attack deals (+54/58/62/66/70%)(+12%) physical damage, applies on-hit effects at 65% effectiveness and Cleaves nearby Enemies for 75% damage.
abilities.name: Unleash

abilities.desc: Cleanse all debuffs and receive a burst of healing.
abilities.gameDescription: Renew your spirit and amplify healing energy. • Cleanses all Debuffs. • Grants Unstoppable for 0.25s. • Heal for {HealAmount}(). • Increased by {RegenMultiplier}x Health Regeneration.
abilities.menuDescription:
Khaimera instantly Cleanses all Debuffs and Heals himself for 5/7/9/11/13% of his maximum health (+4x current health regeneration).

Cleansing grants Crowd Control Immunity for 0.25s.
abilities.name: Invigorate

abilities.desc: Unleash a primal roar, slashing all enemies in front of you for heavy damage and stunning them.
abilities.gameDescription: Emit a blood curdling roar in a forward cone. • Deals {Damage}()Damage over 6 hits. • Supresses for {StunDuration}s. • Final hit Slows by {Slow}% for {SlowDuration}s. • Grants {StackNum} Rage for each Hero or Monster hit.
abilities.menuDescription: After a brief channel, Khaimera slices all Enemies in front of him, Stunning them for 1.25s and dealing 200/400/600 (+200%)(+100%) physical damage over 6 hits. The final hit Slows by 25% for 1.25s. Grants 20 Rage stacks for each Enemy Hero or Monster hit.
abilities.name: Cull

abilities.desc: Equip Mercy to fire a powerful shot, dealing damage and applying Vengeance stacks. Mercy can critically strike, benefits from lifesteal, and applies on-hit effects.
abilities.gameDescription: Fire a powerful shot from your hand cannon. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Mercy can Critically Strike and applies On-Hit Effects. • Benefits from Lifesteal. • Applies {Stacks} Vengeance stacks.
abilities.menuDescription: Equip Mercy to fire a powerful shot dealing 25/30/35/40/45 (+74/78/82/86/90%) physical damage and applying 3 stacks of Vengeance to the Target. Mercy benefits from Lifesteal, can Critically Strike, and applies on-hit effects.
abilities.name: Mercy

abilities.desc: Fire lethal bolts at your prey with your hand crossbow, Wrath.
abilities.gameDescription: Ranged Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.menuDescription: Ranged basic attack dealing 53/55.59/58.32/61.19/64.19/67.34/70.62/74.04/77.6/81.3/85.14/89.12/93.24/97.49/101.89/106.42/111.09/115.9 (+80%) physical damage.
abilities.name: Wrath

abilities.desc: Periodically become empowered, causing your next Basic Attack or Mercy to fire a Raven. The Raven explodes on impact, dealing Current Health damage to nearby enemies.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Periodically become empowered:</>
• Your next Basic Attack or Mercy fires a <EffectText>Raven</>.

The Raven:
• Explodes, dealing <AttackDamageText>Damage</> equal to <HealthText>{Damage}%</> of the target's <HealthText>Current Health</>.
• Deals damage to all enemies in a small area.
abilities.menuDescription:
Nevermore activates every 15/14.5/14/13.5/13/12.5/12/11.5/11/10.5/10/9.5/9/8.5/8/7.5/7/6.5s (-0.5 per Level), empowering Kira.

While empowered, Kira's next Basic Attack or Mercy blast fires a Raven at the target that explodes on impact, dealing <HealthText>(+7% of the Target's Current Health)</> physical damage to all targets in a small area.
abilities.name: Nevermore

abilities.desc:
Passive: Mark enemies with Vengeance, increasing your damage against them.
Active: Purify any enemies that are marked with Vengeance, dealing damage based on stacks and slowing for a duration.
abilities.gameDescription:
Passive: Dealing Damage applies Vengeance for {Duration}s. • Deal {BonusDamagePercent}% Bonus Damage per stack.
Purify all Enemies that are marked with Vengeance. • Deals {Damage} Damage. • Deals an additional {DamagePerStack}()Damage per stack. • Slows by {SlowMagnitude}% for {SlowDuration}s. • Resets Cooldown and refunds {ManaRefundPercent}% Mana if any Enemy is killed.
abilities.menuDescription: Passive: Apply Vengeance to enemies by dealing basic attack or ability damage, increasing damage you deal to them by 0.75% for 3.5s, stacking infinitely. Active: Purify all Enemy Units afflicted with Vengeance, dealing 45/65/85/105/125 physical damage, plus an additional 6/8/10/12/14 (+12%) damage per stack, and Slowing them by 10/15/20/25/30% for 1s. The cooldown is reset and 35% Mana is refunded if Dusk kills any target.
abilities.name: Dusk

abilities.desc: Dash in your current movement direction, and gain power for a duration.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Dash in your current movement direction.</>
• Become briefly <EffectText>Unselectable</>.
• Gain <AttackDamageText>{BonusPhysicalPower} Physical Power</> for <AttackDamageText>{BonusDuration}s</>, stacking up to <AttackDamageText>{MaxStacks}</> times.
• <EffectText>Takedowns</> refresh the <EffectText>Cooldown</>.
abilities.menuDescription:
Dash 475/525/575/625/675 units in your current movement direction, becoming briefly Unselectable and gaining an additional 5/10/15/20/25 Bonus Physical Power for 4s, stacking up to 5 times.

Cooldown Resets on Takedown.
abilities.name: Shadow Glide

abilities.desc: Unleash a torrent of arrows and bullets in an area. Enemies take damage over the duration. You can cast Shadow Glide during this window.
abilities.gameDescription: Unleash a torrent of bullets and arrows. • Deals {Damage}()Damage over {Duration}s. • Lifesteals and can Critically Strike. • Applies {Blight}% Blight for {BlightDuration}s. • Shadow Glide can be cast during this time. • You can move but are Slowed by {SelfSlow}%.
abilities.menuDescription: Unleash a torrent of arrows and bullets for 2.5s, dealing 225/330/435 (+460%) physical damage to all nearby Enemies over the duration and reducing their healing by 45% for 2s. These attacks benefit from lifesteal and can critically strike. While Purge is active, Kira cannot attack or cast abilities, except Shadow Glide, and is Slowed by 30%.
abilities.name: Purge

abilities.desc:
Light strikes the Heavenly Blade, dealing damage in an AoE.
If you are holding the blade, gain a shield.
If the blade is in the world, deal extra damage.
abilities.gameDescription:
Light strikes the Heavenly Blade. • Deals {Damage}()Damage to nearby Enemies. • Holding the Blade grants a {Shield}()Shield for {ShieldDuration}s.
If the Blade is in the world: • Deals {TrueDamage}()Damage around the Blade instead.
abilities.menuDescription: Light strikes the Heavenly Blade, dealing damage to nearby Enemy Units. While holding the Blade, it deals 75/110/145/180/215 (+60%)(+70%) magical damage and grants Kwang a 65/95/125/155/185 (+40%) (+9% ) Shield for 2.5s. If the Blade is in the world, it deals 90/125/160/195/230 (+80%)(+80%) true damage instead.
abilities.name: Light of the Heavens

abilities.desc: Electrify your foes with the Heavenly Blade.
abilities.gameDescription: Melee Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.name: Heavenly Blade

abilities.desc: Dealing ability damage will energise the Heavenly Blade. Whilst Energised, you gain attack speed and your basic attacks deal extra damage in an AoE around the target.
abilities.gameDescription:
On damaging an Enemy with an Ability: • Gain a stack of Energized for {Duration}s, up to a max of 3.
Energized Empowers Basic Attacks: • Gain {AttackSpeed}% Attack Speed. • Strike the Target with a Bolt. • Bolts deal {Damage}()Damage to nearby Enemies. • Hitting a Hero reduces Ability Cooldowns by {CDR}s.
abilities.menuDescription: When Kwang damages an Enemy with an ability his Heavenly Blade becomes Energized with electricity for 4s, stacking up to 3 times. Whilst Energized, Kwang gains 45% attack speed and his next basic attack strikes lightning from above dealing 10/12/14/16/18/21/24/27/30/33/37/41/45/49/53/57/62/67 (+4 per level)(+20%) magical damage to the Target and nearby Enemies. If this damages an Enemy Hero, Kwang reduces his basic ability cooldowns by 0.5s per stack.
abilities.name: Strike of the Heavens

abilities.desc: Throw the Heavenly Blade to a location to deal damage. Enemies become tethered to the blade.
abilities.gameDescription: Throw the Heavenly Blade at a location. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Tethers Enemies hit to the Blade for {TetherDuration}s. • Grants Vision in a small area. • Recast or Basic Attack to bring the Blade back.
abilities.menuDescription: Throw the Heavenly Blade at a target location to deal 90/115/140/165/190 (+40%) magical damage. Enemies hit by the Blade will be Tethered to it for 1.45s. When in the world, the Blade grants vision in a small area around it. Recalling the Blade early will break the Tether.
abilities.name: Judgement of the Heavens

abilities.desc:
Dash forward dealing damage to all enemies passed through.
If the blade is in your path, knock up and deal extra damage to enemies.
abilities.gameDescription:
Become Lightning and rush forward. • Passing through Enemies deals {Damage}()Damage. • Become briefly Unselectable.
If the Blade is in the world: • Dash into the Blade to recall it. • Deals {Damage}()Damage to nearby Enemies. • Knocks Up and Stuns for {StunDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Kwang dashes forward, becoming Unselectable and dealing 75/105/135/165/195 (+45%) to all Enemy Units he passes through. When the Blade is in the world, if Kwang dashes within 300 units of its radius he will summon it back to his hand with a crash of lightning, dealing the damage to all nearby Enemy Units and Knocking them Up for 0.25s.
abilities.name: Surge of the Heavens

abilities.desc: Teleport to the Heavenly Blade creating a massive electrical explosion dealing massive damage to all enemies.
abilities.gameDescription:
Channel a strike with the Heavenly Blade. • Deals {Damage}()Damage to nearby Enemies. • Slows by {SlowMagnitude}% for {SlowDuration}s.
If the Blade is in the world: • Kwang will Teleport to the Blade before striking.
abilities.menuDescription: Channel a strike with the Heavenly Blade, dealing 250/360/470 (+80%) magical damage and applying a 50/60/70% Slow for 2s to nearby Enemy Units. If the Blade is in the world, Kwang will Teleport to it before striking.
abilities.name: Fury of the Heavens

abilities.desc: Cook and lob a Grenade dealing damage to enemies and launching you upwards. If held for full duration the Grenade explodes in your hand.
abilities.gameDescription: Cook a Grenade for up to {Delay}s. • Throw the Grenade at any time. • Explosion deals {Damage}()Damage and Launches up self. • Explodes after 0.2s if near an Enemy. • When Cooked for full Duration, explodes in hand. If Stunned or Killed whilst Cooking, the Grenade drops.
abilities.menuDescription: Legion cooks a Grenade with a 2.2s fuse, reducing the time before detonation based on duration held. Throw the Grenade causing an explosion that deals 70/110/150/190/230 (+60/65/70/75/80%) (+40%) Physical Damage and Launches Legion or Enemies hit. The Grenade automatically explodes after 0.2s if it is near an Enemy. When cooked for the full duration, it will explode in Legion's hand. If Legion is Stunned, Killed or cancels the ability whilst cooking the Grenade, it drops to the floor.
abilities.name: Frag Order

abilities.desc: Gun down enemy hostiles with your highly precise K-75 Storm Rifle.
abilities.gameDescription: Ranged Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}. After not Firing for {ReloadDelay}s: • Ammo gradually Replenishes. Once Magazine is empty, automatically Reloads.
abilities.menuDescription: Ranged basic attack dealing 20/21.16/22.37/23.65/24.99/26.39/27.86/29.38/30.97/32.62/34.33/36.11/37.94/39.84/41.8/43.82/45.91/48.05 (+17%) Physical Damage. This damage is increased by +1.35% per 1 Physical Penetration owned. If Legion does not fire for 1.25 seconds, the rifle's ammo will gradually replenish. When the magazine is empty, Legion reloads his rifle.
abilities.name: K-75 Storm Rifle

abilities.desc: Convert Attack Speed into Ability Haste and enhance your abilities based on purchased stats.
abilities.gameDescription:
Convert 1% Bonus Attack Speed into {AttackSpeedToHaste} Ability Haste.
Abilities gain bonuses based on item stats: • {PhysicalPowerThreshold} : Saturation Charge Slow Duration increased by {SlowDuration}s. • {PhysicalPenThreshold} : Orbital Sanction Radius is increased by {UltimateRadius}%. • {AbilityHasteThreshold} : Frag Order deals {GrenadeDamage}% Missing Health Damage. • {MagicalPowerThreshold} : Rally Point Heal is increased by {HealthRegen}%.
abilities.menuDescription:
Legion converts 1% Bonus Attack Speed into 0.75 Ability Haste.
Legion also gains bonuses based on purchased Item stats:
100 Physical Power: Saturation Charge Slow Duration increased by 0.75s.

30 Physical Penetration: Orbital Sanction's Radius is increased by 33%.

45 Ability Haste: Frag Order deals 10% of the Target's Missing Health as Physical Damage.

80 Magical Power: Rally Point's Heal is increased by 50%.
abilities.name: Ballistic Calibration

abilities.desc: Launch an Energy Rocket that clusters into Mines on impact that deal damage and slow.
abilities.gameDescription: Fire a heavy payload. • Clusters into 10 Mines on impact. • Each Mine deals {Damage}()Damage. • Consecutive hits deal {ReducedDamage}% Damage. • Slows by {Slow}% for {SlowDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Legion fires a heavy payload that deploys 10 Cluster Mines upon hitting the world, Enemies or by reactivation. Each Cluster Mine deals 35/45/55/65/75 (+50%) (+40%) Physical Damage and Slows Enemies hit by 40% for 1s. Consecutive Mine hits on the same Enemy deal 25% Damage.
abilities.name: Saturation Charge

abilities.desc: Place a Standard and gain unstoppable for a short duration and knocking back enemies hit. Allies near the Standard gain movement speed and heal, whilst you gain infinite ammo.
abilities.gameDescription: Call in an inspiring Standard. • Become Unstoppable for 0.5s. • Deals {Damage}()Damage and Knocks back Enemies. The Standard rallies Allied Heroes for {Duration}s: • Grants {Speed}% Movement Speed. • Heals for {Heal}()Health every Second. • Gain Infinite Ammo and detect Enemy Wards.
abilities.menuDescription: Legion calls in a standard and becomes Unstoppable for 0.5s, dealing 20/25/30/35/40 (+20%) Physical Damage whilst Knocking Back nearby Enemies. The Standard rallies nearby Allies for 8s if they remain within 1500 units. Allies gain 8% Movement Speed and heal for 5/8/11/14/17 (+100%) (+10%) Health every Second. Additionally, Enemy Wards are Revealed. Legion gains Infinite Ammo.
abilities.name: Rally Point

abilities.desc: Throw a Designator, after a short delay a Beam will blast the targeted location, following enemies.
abilities.gameDescription: Call in a devastating Orbital Beam after {Delay}s. • Deals {Damage}()Damage every 0.25s. • Tracks Enemy Targets, prioritising Heroes. • Orbital Sanction persists for {Duration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Legion lobs a target designator that deploys upon landing. After a 0.75s delay, an Orbital Beam blasts the designated location, tracking Enemy Targets, prioritising Heroes. Enemy Targets within the blast take 30/50/70 (+26%) (+10%) Physical Damage every 0.25s. The Orbital Beam persists for 6/7.5/9s. If there are no Enemy Targets within 2000 units, the blast remains stationary.
abilities.name: Orbital Sanction

abilities.desc:
Place a bomb that detonates after a short delay, dealing damage.

Innovation: Detonate again after a short time.
abilities.gameDescription: Place a timed bomb. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Restores {ManaRestore} Mana On-Hit. Innovation: Explodes a second time. • Deals {BonusDamage}()Damage.
abilities.menuDescription: Place a bomb that detonates after a short delay, dealing 95/135/175/215/255 (+70%) magical damage. Restores 6/7/8/9/10 Mana for each Enemy hit. Innovation: Detonate a second time after a short delay, dealing 80 (+30%) magical damage.
abilities.name: Void Bomb

abilities.desc: Send bullets down range with your OA-S3000 SMG.
abilities.gameDescription: Ranged Basic Attack. • Fires 3 Rounds. • Each deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.menuDescription: Ranged basic attack that fires 3 rounds, each dealing 21/22.16/23.37/24.65/25.99/27.39/28.86/30.38/31.97/33.62/35.33/37.11/38.94/40.84/42.8/44.82/46.91/49.05 (+25%) physical damage.
abilities.name: OA-S3000 SMG

abilities.desc: Your abilities gain additional strength at maximum rank. Gains increased ability haste each time you max out an ability.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>On an Ability reaching maximum level:</>
• The Ability becomes stronger.
• Gain <EffectText>{Percent}</> increased <EffectText>Ability Haste</>.
abilities.menuDescription:
Lt. Belica's abilities gain additional strength at maximum rank. 

Additionally, she gains 8 Ability Haste each time she maxes out an ability.
abilities.name: Innovation

abilities.desc:
Slam the ground, sending forth a seismic wave that deals damage and knocks up enemies after a short duration.

Innovation: Increased stun duration.
abilities.gameDescription: Lift up the ground forward in a line. • Erupts after 0.5s. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Stuns for {StunDuration}s. Innovation: Stuns for 1.45s instead.
abilities.menuDescription: Slam the ground, sending forth a seismic wave that erupts after 0.5s, dealing 100/140/180/220/260 (+60%) magical damage to all Enemies in its path, Knocking Up and Stunning them for 1s. Innovation: Stun duration increases to 1.4s.
abilities.name: Seismic Assault

abilities.desc:
Deploy a drone that drains enemy mana and attacks them when damaging them with an ability or if they cast an ability, dealing damage and draining their mana.

Innovation: The drone's attacks drain additional mana.
abilities.gameDescription: Deploy an Anti-Mana drone that grants Vision. • Drains {ManaDrain}% of current Enemy Mana each second. • Zaps nearby Heroes that cast Abilities, or on dealing Ability Damage. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Its Attacks drain {ZapDrain}% of Maximum Mana. Innovation: Zaps now drain {MaxedZapDrain}% of Maximum Mana.
abilities.menuDescription: Deploy a drone for 12s that grants vision in the area and drains 2/2.75/3.5/4.25/5% of nearby Enemy Heroes' Current Mana each second. The drone zaps nearby Heroes if they cast an ability, or if Lt. Belica damages them with an ability, dealing 60/70/80/90/100 (+17.5%) magical damage and draining 2.5% of the Target's Maximum Mana. Innovation: Zap Max Mana drain increases to 6%.
abilities.name: Void Drone

abilities.desc:
Fire a piercing blast from your sidearm, dealing damage to targets, increased based on their missing mana, and silencing them. Deals missing health damage to Manaless Heroes instead.

Innovation: Resets Cooldown if an Enemy Hero is killed.
abilities.gameDescription: Release a high-caliber piercing pistol shot. • Deals {Damage}()Damage + {ManaToDamage}% Target's Missing Mana. • Silences for {Silence}s. For Manaless Heroes, the damage is modified: • Deals {Damage}()Damage + {HealthToDamage}% Target's Missing Health. Innovation: Resets Cooldown if Enemy Hero is killed with the blow or shortly after hit by Neural Disruptor.
abilities.menuDescription: Unleash a heavy blast from Lt. Belica's sidearm, dealing 200/325/450 (+65%) magical damage and silencing them for 0.5s. Damage increases by 25/30/35% of the Target's Missing Mana. For Manaless Heroes, the damage increases by 20/25/30% of the Target's Missing Health. Innovation: Resets Cooldown if Enemy Hero is taken down shortly after or with the blast.
abilities.name: Neural Disruptor

abilities.desc: Throw a slow, explosive gemstone to damage and Stun Enemies. Can be reactivated early.
abilities.gameDescription: Fire a slow-moving, explosive gemstone. • Launch a gem that explodes, dealing {Damage}()Damage. • Stuns Enemies hit in a small area for {MinStun}s. • Distance increases Stun duration up to {MaxStun}s. • Can be reactivated to detonate the gem early.
abilities.menuDescription: Maco throws a slow-moving gemstone that explodes at its max range, or when detonated early by reactivating the ability. When the gemstone explodes, it deals 70/95/120/145/170 (+45%) magical damage and Stuns Enemies for 0.5s. Stun Duration increases up to 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3s, based on the distance it travels.
abilities.name: Maco Sparkle!

abilities.desc: Fling small gemstones at Enemies.
abilities.gameDescription: Ranged Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.menuDescription: Ranged basic attack dealing 52/54.73/57.61/60.63/63.8/67.11/70.57/74.18/77.93/81.83/85.88/90.07/94.41/98.9/103.53/108.31/113.23/118.3 (+55%) physical damage.
abilities.name: Ta-da!

abilities.desc: Gain Movement Speed while moving, gaining Slow Immunity at max stacks. Stacks removed on being hit by an Enemy Hero.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Gain extra momentum while moving.</>
• While moving, gain up to <EffectText>{MS}% Movement Speed</>.
• At max speed, gain <EffectText>Slow Immunity</>.
• Taking Damage from Heroes removes all buffs.
• Buffs are also removed after standing still for <EffectText>{Falloff}s</>
abilities.menuDescription:
As Maco moves, he gains stacks of Movement Speed up to 10% (+0.6% per level).

When Maco reaches 25 stacks, he gains Mach Speed, which grants him Slow Immunity.

Taking Damage from Enemy Heroes removes all of the buffs. Standing still for 3s also removes the buffs.
abilities.name: Mach Speed!

abilities.desc: Lob a gemstone that damages Enemies and Heals Allies, additionally granting them Movement Speed.
abilities.gameDescription: Lob a gem that hurts Enemies and Heals Allies. • The gem explodes on contact, dealing {Damage}()Damage. • If the explosion hits Allies, they Heal for {Heal}(). • Allies also Heal for {HealAllyHPScaling}% of their Max Health. • Allies gain {MS}%() Movement Speed for {MSDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Maco lobs a gemstone that explodes in a small area, dealing damage or healing, based on the Target hit. If Maco hits himself or an Ally, they are Healed for 40/60/80/100/120 (+35%) Health in addition to 1/1.5/2/2.5/3% of their Max Health. Allies also gain 8/9/10/11/12 (+3%) Movement Speed for 2.5s. If Maco hits an Enemy, they take 75/105/135/165/195 (+45%) magical damage.
abilities.name: Maco Gift!

abilities.desc: Leap high into the air and crush enemies with your giant gem, damaging and Slowing Enemies. Gain a Shield for hitting Enemy Heroes.
abilities.gameDescription: Leap high in the sky, slamming into the ground. • On landing, deal {Damage}()Damage in an area. • Additionally, Enemies are Slowed by {Slow}%() for {SlowDuration}s. • Hitting an Enemy Hero grants a {Shield}() Shield for {ShieldDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Maco leaps high into the air before slamming back down to the ground with his gemstone, dealing 75/105/135/165/195 (+70%) magical damage to Enemies and Slowing them by 30% (+5%) for 1.5s. If Maco hits an Enemy Hero, he gains a 60/115/170/225/280 (+50%) (+4%) Shield for 3.5s. After landing, Maco dashes slightly in the direction he is currently moving.
abilities.name: Maco Fly!

abilities.desc: Charge up and send a giant gemstone flying, damaging and Pushing Enemy Heroes. The gemstone then explodes, damaging and Stunning in an area.
abilities.gameDescription: Send a giant gem flying, running over Enemies. • Charge for up to {Charge}s, increasing the gem's range. • Enemies take {Damage}()Damage, are Pushed, and Stunned. • Explodes at max range, dealing {ExplosionDamage}()Damage. • The explosion also Stuns Enemies for {StunMin}-{StunMax}s, based on charge time.
abilities.menuDescription: Maco charges up his gemstone for up to 1s, increasing the range it travels. When Maco releases the charged gemstone, it barrels forward along the ground, dealing 70/110/150 (+35%) magical damage and Pushing and Stunning all Enemies it hits along with it. At the gemstone's max range, it explodes, dealing 100/160/220 (+50%) magical damage and Stunning all Enemies hit for 0.25-1.4s, based on charge time.
abilities.name: Maco Strike!

abilities.desc: Deal damage to a target, restoring health. If they are a Hero, their soul is rended into your doll, Marking them.
abilities.gameDescription: Rend the soul of your Target. • Deals {Damage}()Damage and restores {Heal}() Health. • On Kill, refunds {Cooldown}% of its Cooldown and {Mana}% of Cost. • Enemy Heroes become Marked. Against Heroes afflicted with Pestilence: • Healing is increased by +{BonusHealing}% per stack.
abilities.menuDescription: Select an Enemy Target to deal 60/80/100/120/140 (+45%) magical damage and, if they are a Hero, Mark them. Damaging Enemy Targets with Mark absorbs part of their soul restoring 8/18/28/38/48 (+20%) Health, increasing by 15% against Heroes for each stack of Pestilence they possess. Killing an Enemy Unit with Mark refunds 50% of its cooldown, and 65% of the Mana spent.
abilities.name: Mark

abilities.desc: Throw Fetid Daggers at your enemies.
abilities.gameDescription: Ranged Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.menuDescription: Ranged basic attack dealing 50/52.8/55.75/58.85/62.1/65.5/69.05/72.75/76.6/80.6/84.75/89.05/93.5/98.1/102.85/107.75/112.8/118 (+55%) physical damage.
abilities.name: Fetid Dagger

abilities.desc: Your abilities apply Pestilence for a duration, dealing damage over time.
abilities.gameDescription: On damaging an Enemy with an Ability: • Apply Pestilence for {Duration}s. • Deals {Damage}()% Maximum Health Damage every {Period}s. • Deals reduced damage to Monsters. • Stacks up to {Stacks} times. • Fetid Dagger hits refresh the duration.
abilities.menuDescription: Morigesh's damaging abilities apply Pestilence for 3s, dealing 0.14% (+0.05% per 100 Magical Power) of the target's maximum health as magical damage every 0.5s, stacking up to 4 times. Fetid Daggers refreshes the duration of Pestilence when it damages a target afflicted by it.
abilities.name: Pestilence

abilities.desc: Throw a hive of insects that explodes dealing damage and Slowing targets hit.
abilities.gameDescription: Throw a hive of locusts that explodes on impact. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Slows them by {Slow}%, decaying over {SlowDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Throw a hive of insects that explodes dealing 100/140/180/220/260 (+65%) magical damage and Slowing targets hit by 50%, decaying over 3s.
abilities.name: Hive

abilities.desc: Become the swarm, gaining movement speed and damage reduction for a duration. Passing through enemies deals damage and restores health.
abilities.gameDescription: Become a swarm of locusts. • Gain {DecayingSpeed}% Decaying Movement Speed for {Duration}s. • Gain {DR}%() Damage Reduction for the same Duration. • Passing through Enemy Targets deals {Damage}()Damage. • Heals you for {Heal}% of Pre-mitigated Damage dealt. • Healing is decreased by {MinionReduction}% against Non-Heroes. • Fully refreshes Duration upon damaging a Hero. • Extends Duration by {NonHeroExtension}s upon damaging Non-Heroes.
abilities.menuDescription: Become the swarm, gaining 50% decaying Movement Speed and 12% (+1.5%) Damage Reduction for 3.5s. Passing through Enemy Units deals 110/150/190/230/270 (+75%) magical damage and restores health equal to 30% of the pre-mitigated damage dealt. Healing is reduced by 75% against Minions. Swarm's effect is fully refreshed if it damages an Enemy Hero, and its duration is extended by 0.5s when colliding with Non-Heroes. Morigesh also gains an additional 25% Decaying Movement Speed over 1s when colliding with Non-Heroes.
abilities.name: Swarm

abilities.desc: Summon a horde of insects to stab the marked target, dealing massive damage.
abilities.gameDescription: Summon locusts to stab the Marked Target. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Marked is removed upon casting this Ability.
abilities.menuDescription: After a brief channel, Summon a horde of insects to stab the Marked target, dealing 320/450/580 (+80%) magical damage. The Mark is removed upon casting this ability.
abilities.name: Curse

abilities.desc: Wind up powerful vines that launch forward, damaging and pulling the first unfortunate enemy target hit towards you.
abilities.gameDescription: Prepare to unleash your vines. • Channel for {MaxChannelTime}s, reaching max Range after {MaxRangeTime}s. • {CooldownRefund}% Cooldown if cancelled or when the 3s Channel expires. • Slows self by {SelfSlow}% whilst channeling. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Pull Enemies towards your location. • Slows by {Slow}% for {SlowDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Channel for up to 3s, Slowing yourself by 25% and wind up your vines, increasing their range over 1s. After 3s the ability will be cancelled and go on a 50% cooldown. Confirm to unleash the vines that will collide with the first enemy target hit dealing 80/125/170/215/260 (+85%) magical damage, Pulling them towards Mourn and Slowing them by 90% for 0.75s.
abilities.name: Abduct

abilities.desc: Bludgeon enemies with your wooden fist.
abilities.gameDescription: Melee Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.name: Clobber

abilities.desc: Swipe with a magical vine that damages enemies, absorbing their essence, healing Mourn.
abilities.gameDescription: Your next Basic Attack is enhanced: • Gain 100% Cleave. • Deals {Damage}()Damage to all Targets hit. • Restores {Healing}()Health.
abilities.menuDescription: Mourn's next basic attack will deal an additional 20/28/36/44/52/60/68/76/84/92/100/108/116/124/132/140/148/156 (+50%)(+90%)(+6% ) magical damage to all targets hit. Damaging an Enemy Target will restore (3%/5%/7%/9% Maximum Health) Health.
abilities.name: Extract

abilities.desc: Vomit bugs that heal and protect Allied Heroes whilst damaging and shredding Enemies.
abilities.gameDescription: Vomit bugs at nearby Heroes & Monsters. Allies: • Restore {Healing}()Health over {Duration}s. • Gain {PhysicalArmor}()Physical Armor and {MagicalArmor}()Magical Armor. Enemies: • Take {Damage}()Damage over {DamageDuration}s. • Lose {Shred} + {PercentShred}% Physical Armor and {Shred} + {PercentShred}% Magical Armor.
abilities.menuDescription: Mourn vomits magical bugs that attach to nearby Heroes and Monsters. Mourn and Allied Heroes hit restore 3/6/9/12/15 (+7%) health every 0.5s for 3s, gaining 5 (+8% Physical Armor) Physical Armor and 5 (+8% Magical Armor) Magical Armor for the same duration. Enemies take 8/12/16/20/24 (+8%) magical damage every 0.5s for 3s and have their Base Physical Armor and Base Magical Armor reduced by 5 and their Bonus Physical Armor and Bonus Magical Armor reduced by 12%.
abilities.name: Contagion

abilities.desc: Channel energy, slowing yourself but gaining damage reduction. After the duration or upon reactivation, damage and mesmerize nearby enemies.
abilities.gameDescription: Project a dreadful light. • Channel a light for up to {Duration}s. • The Radius and Mesmerize increase over {MaxChargeTime}s. • Slows self by {Slow}% and gain {DR}% Damage Reduction. After the duration, the light erupts: • Deals {Damage}()Damage to all Enemies within. • Mesmerizes Enemies hit for {MinimumCharmDuration}-{CharmDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Mourn channels energy into his fist for up to 2.1s, expanding up to 800u over 1.5s. While channeling, Mourn gains 20% Damage Reduction and Slows himself by 30%. At the end of the duration, or upon reactivation, Enemies within take 80/110/140/170/200 (+45%) magical damage and are Mesmerized for 0.45-1.2s (based on 0-1.5s channel duration).
abilities.name: Beguile

abilities.desc: Channel and absorb all light from the galaxy, preventing Enemy Heroes from seeing beyond a small radius. You also apply Contagion to all Heroes and grant yourself movement speed for the duration.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Channel and absorb all Light for {Duration}s.</>
• Massively reduce the <EffectText>Vision</> of Enemy Heroes.
• Apply <AbilityName>Contagion</> to all Heroes in the world.
• Gain <EffectText>{MovementSpeed}% Movement Speed</>.
abilities.menuDescription:
Mourn channels to absorb all light from the map for 4s, causing all Enemy Heroes to have massively reduced vision.

Additionally, Mourn applies Contagion to all Heroes in the world and gains 40/60/80% Movement Speed for the duration.
abilities.name: Eclipse

abilities.desc: Discharge a shotgun blast, dealing more damage the closer the enemy is and reducing their armour. The blast pushes enemies back.
abilities.gameDescription: Fire your shotgun in a cone. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Damage decreases by up to 50% based on distance. • Pierces Terrain. • Shreds Physical Armor by {ShredPercent}% for {Duration}s. • Pushes Back, increasing at close range.
abilities.menuDescription: Discharge a Terrain piercing shotgun blast, dealing 60/90/120/150/180 (+100/120/140/160/180%) physical damage to all Enemies hit, decreasing by up to 50% based on distance and Shredding their physical armor by 15% for 4s. The blast Pushes Enemies Back, its force increasing at close range.
abilities.name: Buckshot

abilities.desc: Bombard your enemies with bullets from your hip fired rifle, The Enforcer.
abilities.gameDescription: Ranged Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.menuDescription: Ranged basic attack dealing 57/59.8/62.75/65.85/69.1/72.5/76.05/79.75/83.6/87.6/91.75/96.05/100.5/105.1/109.85/114.75/119.8/125 (+85%) physical damage.
abilities.name: The Enforcer

abilities.desc: Periodically, your next basic attack has increased range and deals more damage.
abilities.gameDescription: Successful Basic Attacks charge your Rifle. • After {Attacks} successful Basic Attacks your Rifle becomes Charged. • Charged Basic Attacks deal {Damage}()Bonus Damage. • Charged Basic Attacks have {IncreasedRange} additional Range.
abilities.menuDescription: Landing 5 successful Basic Attacks will cause Murdock's next Basic Attack to have 400 increased range and deal (+36-60%) bonus damage.
abilities.name: Shots Fired

abilities.desc: Place an energy trap that deals damage and roots enemy heroes.
abilities.gameDescription: Place a trap on the ground. • Arms after a short delay and lasts {LifeTime}s. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Roots for {RootDuration}s. • Up to {NumTraps} can be placed at once. • Store up to 2 traps.
abilities.menuDescription: Place a trap that arms after a short delay, dealing 40/80/120/160/200 (+100%)(+120%) magical damage to any Enemy Hero that steps on it and Rooting them for 1.25s. Traps last for 40/45/50/55/60s and up to 3/3/4/4/5 may be placed at one time. Max Charges: 2.
abilities.name: Static Trap

abilities.desc: Activate your sirens, gaining movement speed and attack speed.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Activate sirens.</>
• Gain <EffectText>{DecayingMovementSpeed}% Decaying Movement Speed</> for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>.
• Gain <EffectText>{AttackSpeed}% Attack Speed</> for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>, stacking up to <EffectText>{MaxStacks}</> times.
• Resets <EffectText>Cooldown</> on <EffectText>Takedown</>.
abilities.menuDescription:
Murdock activates his sirens, granting him 25% decaying movement speed for 4s. During this time, Murdock gains 15/20/25/30/35% attack speed, stacking on re-activation up to 5 times.

Cooldown Resets on Takedown.
abilities.name: Hot Pursuit

abilities.desc: Kneel and prepare an energised sniper shot with unlimited range that can travel through anything. This shot deals massive damage.
abilities.gameDescription: Fire a massive sniper shot. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Ignores all Physical Armor. • Passes through all Terrain. • Unlimited Range. Targeting: Press Alternate Ability Input to zoom in.
abilities.menuDescription: Murdock kneels, preparing an energized sniper shot with unlimited range that can travel through anything. While targeting, using the Alternate Ability input will zoom the scope inwards. Upon firing, it deals 280/430/580 (+120%)(+100%) physical damage to all Enemies in its path, ignoring any physical armor.
abilities.name: Long Arm of the Law

abilities.desc: Charge up a piercing bolt of energy that damages and slows enemies. Deals increased damage and stuns at full charge.
abilities.gameDescription: Charge a piercing energy bolt for up to {MaxTime}s. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Slows by {Percent}% for {Duration}s. • Cancel the charge to refund {Cooldown}% Cooldown and {Cost}% Cost. Upon reaching Max Charge after {MaxCharge}s: • Deals {MaxDamage}()Damage. • Stuns for {StunDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Charge a piercing bolt of energy for up to 4s that deals 70/105/140/175/210 (+50%) magical damage to all Enemies in its path and Slows by 35% for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s. If Muriel charges Serenity for 1.1s it reaches max charge and deals 98/147/196/245/294 (+70%) magical damage and Stuns the target for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s instead. If Muriel cancels the charge, 50% of the cooldown and 50% of the cost is refunded.
abilities.name: Serenity

abilities.desc: Turn your shielding energy offensive with this ranged basic attack.
abilities.gameDescription: Ranged Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.menuDescription: Ranged basic attack dealing 52/54.49/57.1/59.85/62.74/65.76/68.91/72.19/75.61/79.16/82.84/86.66/90.61/94.69/98.9/103.25/107.74/112.35 (+80%) physical damage.
abilities.name: Orb

abilities.desc: Muriel’s abilities apply anti-heal to enemies and grant a buff to Allies that increases the healing and shielding they receive.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Abilities apply effects for {Duration}s.</>
• Enemies suffer <EffectText>{Blight}%</> reduced <HealthText>Healing</>.
• Allies gain <EffectText>{Buff}%</> increased <HealthText>Healing</> & <EffectText>Shielding</> Received.
abilities.menuDescription:
Muriel's damaging abilities reduce Enemy Healing by 25/25/25/25/25/25/35/35/35/35/35/35/45/45/45/45/45/45/35/45% for 4s.

Allies affected by Muriel's abilities gain 10% (+0.4% per Level) increased Healing and Shielding Received for 4s.
abilities.name: Sentinel

abilities.desc: Bless a large area, granting attack speed and health regeneration to Allies within. Enemies standing in the zone take damage over time and suffer reduced attack speed.
abilities.gameDescription: Create a sanctified zone for {Duration}s. • Allies gain {AttackSpeed}% Total Attack Speed. • Allies restore {Heal}() Health over the duration. • Deals {Damage}() Damage to Enemies over the duration. • Reduces Enemy Total Attack Speed by {AttackSpeedSlow}%.
abilities.menuDescription: Sanctify the ground with an angelic light for 6s. Allies within the area gain 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% Total Attack Speed and restore 60/80/100/120/140 (+20%) Health over its lifetime. Enemies within the area have their Total Attack Speed reduced by 10/11.5/13/14.5/16% and receive 90/120/150/180/210 (+50%) magical damage over its lifetime.
abilities.name: Consecrated Ground

abilities.desc: Throw an orb that shields and grants movement speed to yourself or Allied Heroes.
abilities.gameDescription: Throw an orb. • Applies a {Shield}()Shield to an Allied Hero. • Grants them {Percent}% Decaying Movement Speed for {Duration}s. • Remains in the world for 8s if untouched.
abilities.menuDescription: Throw an orb that applies a 80/120/160/200/240 (+50%) shield to the first Allied Hero it touches, granting them 15/17.5/20/22.5/25% Decaying Movement Speed for 4s. Remains in the world for 8s if untouched.
abilities.name: Alacrity

abilities.desc: Grant an Allied Hero damage reduction and a large shield for a short duration before soaring to their location. On arrival, damage and knock up nearby enemies.
abilities.gameDescription: Fly to a target Allied Hero. • Infinite range. • Grants {DR}% Damage Reduction and a {Shield}() Shield for {Duration}s. • On arrival, create a shockwave. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Knocks Up for {Stun}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Prepare for flight, allowing Muriel to target an Allied Hero anywhere in the world, granting them 30% Damage Reduction and a 280/480/680 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s as you soar to their location. On arrival, nearby Enemies take 100/160/220 (+40%) magical damage and are Knocked Up for 0.5s.
abilities.name: Reversal Of Fortune

abilities.desc: Toss a Drumclub that damages and stuns enemies in a tiny area around the target.
abilities.gameDescription: Throw a drumstick. • Deals {Damage}()Damage in a tiny AoE. • Knocks Back and Stuns for {Duration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Toss a drumstick that deals 95/140/185/230/275 (+85%)(+130%) magical damage in a tiny area of effect, Knocking Back and Stunning the Enemies hit for 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3s.
abilities.name: Thunk

abilities.desc: Beat your opponents like a drum with your Drumclubs.
abilities.gameDescription: Melee Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.name: Drumclubs

abilities.desc: Gain increased physical power and armors for each nearby Hero.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>For each nearby Hero within a {Radius}u radius:</>
• Gain <AttackDamageText>{Power} Physical Power</>.
• Gain <AttackDamageText>{PhysArmor} Physical Armor</>.
• Gain <AbilityPowerText>{MagicArmor} Magical Armor</>.
abilities.menuDescription: Narbash gains 2/2.5/3/3.5/4/4.5/5/5.5/6/6.5/7/7.5/8/8.5/9/9.5/10/10.5 (+0.5 per level) Physical Power, Physical Armor and Magical Armor for each nearby Allied or Enemy Hero within a 1700u radius.
abilities.name: Mosh Pit

abilities.desc: Bellow out a rallying war cry, bolstering Song Of My People for a duration.
abilities.gameDescription: Bellow out a rallying war cry. • Grants empowered effects based on Song of My People's current stance for {Duration}s. Healing: Gain {Heal}() Health Regeneration. Speed: Gain {Speed}%() Movement Speed.
abilities.menuDescription: Bellow out a rallying war cry, granting Narbash and empowered version of Song of My People for himself and his nearby Allies for 3/3.25/3.5/3.75/4s. Speed: Gain 15/17.5/20/22.5/25% (+4.5%) Movement Speed. Healing: Gain 15/20/25/30/35 (+20%) Health Regeneration.
abilities.name: March!

abilities.desc: Toggle: Play a soothing beat to either heal, or grant increased movement speed, to yourself and nearby Allies.
abilities.gameDescription: Toggle: Play a soothing Aura. Healing Aura: Grant {Heal}() Health Regeneration. Speed Aura: Grant {Speed}%() Movement Speed.
abilities.menuDescription: Toggle: Play a soothing beat, granting Narbash and his Allies additional Speed or Healing. Healing Aura: Grants 1.5/2.5/3.5/4.5/5.5 (+2%) Health Regeneration. Speed Aura: Grants 4.5/5.5/6.5/7.5/8.5% (+3%) Movement Speed.
abilities.name: Song Of My People

abilities.desc: Channel a drum solo over a short duration that slows nearby enemies, before mesmerizing them. The final beat of the solo deals increased damage, knocking up and stunning targets hit.
abilities.gameDescription: Channel a drum solo for {Duration}s. • You are Slowed by {SelfSlowPercent}%. • Deals {TickDamage}() Damage over the Duration. • Every hit Slows enemies by {Slow}%, stacking up to {Stacks} times. • At max Slow stacks, targets become Mesmerized instead. • Final hit deals {FinalDamage}() Damage. • Final hit Knocks Up and Stuns for {StunDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Narbash Slows himself by 30% and Channels a drum solo for 3s. Nearby Enemies receive 5/7.5/10 (+4%)(+7%) magical damage per hit and are Slowed by 5%, stacking up to 5 times. Enemies afflicted with maximum Slow stacks become Mesmerized instead. The final hit deals 80/150/220 (+80%)(+120%) magical damage, Knocking Up all Enemies and Stunning them for 0.5s.
abilities.name: Crash Bang Boom!

abilities.desc: Dissolve into a data stream and dash, leaving fading holographic copies in your path. Your next Jolt explodes, damaging and slowing enemies.
abilities.gameDescription: Become a Stream of Data. • Dash in your current movement direction. • Your next Jolt explodes, dealing {Damage}() Bonus Damage. • Slows Targets by {Slow}% for {SlowDuration}s. Overclocked: Can be Recast once within {RecastTimer}s at no cost.
abilities.menuDescription: Dash in the current movement direction, Empowering your next Jolt within 3s to explode, dealing 60/85/110/135/160 (+40%) bonus Magical Damage to the target and nearby enemies as well as Slowing them by 20% for 0.5s. Overclocked: Can be Recast once within 3s at no cost.
abilities.name: Erase Vector

abilities.desc: Fire Energy bolts at your enemies.
abilities.gameDescription: Ranged Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.menuDescription: Ranged basic attack dealing 52/54.31/56.74/59.3/61.98/64.79/67.72/70.77/73.94/77.24/80.67/84.22/87.89/91.68/95.6/99.64/103.81/108.1 (+60%) physical damage.
abilities.name: Jolt

abilities.desc: Weave your spells to generate Threads. Once complete, your system Overclocks, empowering your next basic ability.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Cast Basic Abilities to gain stacks of Thread</>:
• Gain <EffectText>1</> stack of <EffectText>Thread</> per <EffectText>Basic Ability</> cast.
• Enter Base to gain <EffectText>3</> stacks.

Upon reaching <EffectText>3</> Stacks
• Your next <EffectText>Basic Ability</> becomes <AbilityName>Overclocked</>, granting 
 an empowered effect.
abilities.menuDescription:
Casting a Basic Ability grants one Thread. At 3 Threads, Neon's next basic ability becomes
Overclocked, consuming the stacks to unleash a powerful additional effect.
abilities.name: Neural Network

abilities.desc: Release a Data Construct that shears through enemies in its path. It returns to your location, dealing True Damage on the recall.
abilities.gameDescription: Release a Data Construct that returns to you. • Deals {Damage}() Damage to Enemies in a line. • Deals {ReturnDamage}() True Damage while returning. Overclocked: Emits a pulse at max range, dealing {ReturnDamage}() True Damage.
abilities.menuDescription: Neon sends out a Data Construct, dealing 48/69/90/111/132 (+42.5%) Magical Damage to enemies it passes through. The Data Construct then returns to Neon, dealing 48/69/90/111/132 (+42.5%) True Damage on its way back. Overclocked: Before returning, the Data Construct emits a pulse at its maximum range, dealing 48/69/90/111/132 (+42.5%) True Damage.
abilities.name: L.I.N.X

abilities.desc: Launch a volatile data cluster that detonates on impact, damaging and slowing enemies caught in the blast radius.
abilities.gameDescription: Launch a Data Cluster. • Detonates 0.5s after impact. • Deals {Damage}() Damage in an area. • Slows by {Slow}% for {CCDuration}s. Overclocked: Targets are also Mesmerised.
abilities.menuDescription: Neon lobs a projectile. After 0.5s of landing or colliding with an enemy target, it detonates, dealing 85/120/155/190/225 (+60%) Magical Damage and slowing targets by 35% for 1/1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4s. Overclocked: Targets are Mesmerized as well as Slowed.
abilities.name: Data Burst

abilities.desc: Push your systems beyond their limits, entering a state of hyper-mobility where every ability is permanently Overclocked. You may end the protocol early to launch an explosive finisher.
abilities.gameDescription:
Enter System Overdrive for {Duration}s. • All Basic Abilities are Overclocked for the duration. • Grants {MoveSpeed}% Movement Speed and {JumpHeight}% Jump Height.
Recast: • Launch a bomb dealing {Damage}() Damage. • Damage increases by up to {MissingHealthDamage}% based on the Target's Missing Health.
abilities.menuDescription: Neon Overclocks her systems for 8s, gaining 15/20/25% Movement Speed, 45% Jump Height, and causing all her Basic Abilities to be Overclocked for the duration. Recast: During System Overdrive, Neon can recast this ability to jump upwards and launch an explosive bomb, dealing 155/225/295 (+55/60/65%) magical damage, increased by up to 90% based on the target's missing health.
abilities.name: Final Thread

abilities.desc: Create a link between yourself and an ally, granting both increased power. If reactivated, pull the linked ally towards you.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Create a Link between yourself and an Ally.</>
• Grants both Heroes <EffectText>{Damage}%</> increased <EffectText>Power</>.
• Double Tapping <CC_Text>Pulls</> the <EffectText>Linked</> Ally towards you. 
• The <EffectText>Link</> will break if her Ally is out of range for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>. 
• Allies that are <CC_Text>Immobilized</> cannot be <CC_Text>Pulled</>.
abilities.menuDescription:
Create a Link between yourself and an Ally, granting both Heroes 3/4/5/6/7% increased Physical Power and Magical Power. If reactivated, Phase will Pull the Linked Ally towards her.

The Link will turn Pink if any Ally wanders too far out of range and will break if they do not return within 1s.

Allies that are Immobilized cannot be Pulled.
