abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>On Hero Takedown:</>
• The Hero drops a demonic visage for <EffectText>10s</>.
• Upon touching it, activate <AbilityName>Heresy</> at no cost. 
• Reduces current <EffectText>Basic Ability Cooldowns</> by <EffectText>{CooldownReduction}%</>.
abilities.menuDescription:
Takedowns on Enemy Heroes leave behind a demonic visage for 10s.

Upon touching it, Serath activates Heresy at no cost and reduces her current basic ability cooldowns by 65%.
abilities.name: Fallen Grace

abilities.desc: Mark a target and vanish, striking enemies at their location. Each strike deals damage. Then, teleport to the marked enemy's location.
abilities.gameDescription: Disappear and dash to your Target. • Become CC Immune and Invulnerable. • Strike Enemies at your Target's location {NumberOfSlashes} times. • Strikes deal {Damage}()Damage. • Deals {ExtraAttackDamageReduction}% Damage for subsequent hits. • Strikes apply On-Hit Effects at {OnHitModifier}% effectiveness. • Monsters receive {MonsterDamage} additional Damage per strike. • Reappear at the Target's location.
abilities.menuDescription: Serath marks a Target and vanishes, striking Enemies at their location 5 times. Each strike deals 40/60/80/100/120 (+20%) physical damage and applies on-hit effects at 35% effectiveness. Additional strikes against the same Target deal 30% damage. Deals 40/50/60/70/80 bonus damage to Monsters. On her final strike, Serath will teleport to the marked Target's location based on her current position. If the marked Target dies, Serath teleports immediately.
abilities.name: Heaven's Fury

abilities.desc: Rise up into the air and hover while targetting an area. Then, dive down and deal damage.
abilities.gameDescription: Rise up and target an area to attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Triggers automatically after {HoverTime}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Serath rises up into the air and hovers for up to 1.8s. During this time, she can target an area up to 1350 units away. Upon confirmation, she dives down and deals 80/100/120/140/160 (+80%)(+50%) physical damage. Serath automatically dives to the ground after 1.8s
abilities.name: Ascend

abilities.desc: Take on your demonic form, dealing damage to nearby enemies and setting them ablaze. Gain movement speed, attack speed, and damage over time on your basic attacks.
abilities.gameDescription: Take demonic form to gain immense power for {Duration}s. • Deals {Damage}()Damage around you. • Gain {Movespeed}% Movement Speed. • Gain {Attackspeed}% Attack Speed. Grants Infernal Strikes: • Deal {BurnDamage}()Damage On-Hit over {BurnDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Serath takes demonic form, dealing 60/90/120 (+50%)(+80%) physical damage to nearby Enemies and setting them ablaze. For the next 7s, she gains 20/25/30% movement speed, 20/40/60% attack speed, and empowers her basic attack with Infernal Strikes. Infernal Strikes sets Enemy Units ablaze on-hit, dealing 14/26/38 (+20%)(+20%) true damage on-hit over 2s.
abilities.name: Heresy

abilities.desc: Dash forward, gliding through any Enemies in your path, dealing damage and causing targets hit to run away in fear.
abilities.gameDescription: Glide forward, draining all Enemies. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Fears for {FearDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Sevarog dashes forward through the air, dealing 40/60/80/100/120 (+2.5%) magical damage to all Enemies he passes through and Fearing them for 1s.
abilities.name: Phantom Rush

abilities.desc: Beat your enemies into submission with The Harbinger
abilities.gameDescription: Melee Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.name: The Harbinger

abilities.desc: Gains Souls when killing enemies with abilities. Each Soul grants bonus health, and Sevarog gains new effects after set amounts are gained.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>On killing Enemies with Abilities:</>
• Gain a <EffectText>Soul</> that grants <HealthText>{HealthPerStack}</> <HealthText>Health</>.
• <EffectText>{StacksT1}/{StacksT2}/{StacksT3}/{StacksT4} Souls</> grant <HealthText>{HealthT1}/{HealthT2}/{HealthT3}/{HealthT4} Health</>.
• <EffectText>{StacksT1} Souls</>: <EffectText>{Omnivamp}% Omnivamp</>.
• <EffectText>{StacksT2} Souls</>: <AbilityPowerText>{Shred}% Magical Armor Shred</> <EffectText>Hero Aura</>.
• <EffectText>{StacksT3} Souls</>: <AbilityName>Siphon</> grants <EffectText>{SiphonHealthMultiplier}x</> <HealthText>Max Health</> from Stealing.
• <EffectText>{StacksT4} Souls</>: <EffectText>Reflect {ReflectDamage}%</> of damage taken to nearby Enemies.
abilities.menuDescription:
Sevarog gains Souls when he Kills an Enemy with an ability. Each Soul grants 2 bonus health. 

Sevarog reaches an additional Tier of power at 40/80/120/160 Souls, gaining 40/80/180/350 bonus health and new effects:
• Tier 1: +5% Omnivamp.
• Tier 2: Gain an Aura that Shreds nearby Enemy Heroes' Magical Armor by 15%.
• Tier 3: Siphon grants 2x Maximum Health from Stealing.
• Tier 4: Reflect 10% of damage taken to nearby enemies.
abilities.name: Reaper of Souls

abilities.desc: Strike forward with a spectral hand, dealing damage and temporarily stealing Maximum Health from Enemy Heroes
abilities.gameDescription: Strike forward with a spectral hand. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Steals {Steal}% Max Health from Enemy Heroes for {Duration}s. • Deals {MonsterDamage} additional Damage to Monsters.
abilities.menuDescription: Strike forward with a spectral hand, dealing 80/95/110/125/140 (+4% )(+40%) magical damage to all Enemies. Deals 40/45/50/55/60 additional damage to Monsters. If Siphon damages an Enemy Hero, Sevarog steals 1.8/2/2.2/2.4/2.6% of their Maximum Health for 15s.
abilities.name: Siphon

abilities.desc: Call down a miasma of dark energy, dealing damage and chaining enemies to the centre. Chained targets that move away from the centre break the chain, damaging and stunning them.
abilities.gameDescription: Call down a miasma of dark energy. • Deal {Damage}()Damage. • Chain Enemies to the centre for {ChainDuration}s. • Chained Enemies are Slowed by {Slow}%. Chained Enemies that leave the zone: • Take {ChainDamage}()Damage. • Stunned for {Stun}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Call down a miasma of dark energy, dealing 60/75/90/105/120 (+40%) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Slowing them by 30% and Chaining them to the center for 2s. If a Chained target leaves the zone, they take 75/90/105/120/135 (+60%) magical damage and are Stunned for 1.25s.
abilities.name: Subjugate

abilities.desc: Deliver a heavy blow from The Harbinger, dealing damage and sending all enemies flying.
abilities.gameDescription: Deliver a heavy blow from your hammer. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Heroes are Knocked Back. • Executes Minions at Max Rank.
abilities.menuDescription: Deliver a heavy blow from Sevarog's hammer, dealing 200/330/460 (+75%) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him. Enemy Heroes struck by the blow are Knocked Back, sending them flying. At maximum rank, Colossal Blow Executes Minions.
abilities.name: Colossal Blow

abilities.desc: Dash forward, dealing damage to all enemies you pass through.
abilities.gameDescription: Dash forward. • Pass through all Units. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Charges: 2.
abilities.menuDescription: Shinbi dashes forward through the air, dealing 50/85/120/155/190 (+55%) magical damage to all Enemies she passes through. Max Charges: 2
abilities.name: Rushing Beat

abilities.desc: Dice up your enemies with your sword.
abilities.gameDescription: Melee Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.name: Kiba

abilities.desc: Basic attacks deal additional damage. Periodically this effect deals even more damage and restores mana.
abilities.gameDescription:
• Deal an additional {Damage}()Damage On-Hit.
On dealing damage with a Basic Attack: • Deals {Multiplier}x Damage and applies Track. • Restores {Mana} Mana.
abilities.menuDescription: Shinbi's Basic Attacks deal an additional 12 (+10%)(+10%) magical damage on-hit. Every 10s (-0.4s per Level), Shinbi's next Basic Attack applies Biting Melody for 2.5x damage, applying Track to the target, and restoring 20/26/32/38/44/50/56/62/68/74/80/86/92/98/104/110/116/122 (+6 per Level) Mana.
abilities.name: Biting Melody

abilities.desc: Summon a spirit wolf that runs in a straight line and passes through all enemies, dealing damage.
abilities.gameDescription: Summon a Spirit Wolf that runs in a straight line. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Passes through all Units. • Subsequent hits deal {Modifier}% Damage to Minions.
abilities.menuDescription: Summon a Spirit Wolf that runs in a straight line towards your reticule and passes through all Enemy Targets dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+55%) magical damage. After hitting a target, deals 60% damage to subsequent Minions.
abilities.name: Line Tempo

abilities.desc: Summon spirit wolves that circle you, granting movement speed and a shield for a duration. The wolves deal damage to nearby enemies.
abilities.gameDescription: Summon 4 Spirit Wolves that circle you. • Grants {Percent}% Decaying Movement Speed. • Grants a {Shield}()Shield. • Lasts {Duration}s. • Deals {Damage}()Damage over the Duration. After the Duration: • Grants another {Shield}()Shield.
abilities.menuDescription: After a short delay, summon 4 Spirit Wolves that circle Shinbi for 2.4s, granting 20% decaying movement speed and a 45/65/85/105/125 (+35%) shield for the same duration and after the wolves expire. The wolves deal 30/42/54/66/78 (+22%) magical damage per hit, up to 3 times.
abilities.name: Circle Rhythm

abilities.desc:
Passive: Damaging Enemy Heroes with abilities marks them and grants stacks of Track for a duration. At maximum stacks, you may activate All-Kill.
Active: Summon a pack of spirit wolves above marked Heroes that strike them, dealing damage with each hit.
abilities.gameDescription:
Passive: Ability hits on Heroes grant Track for {StackDuration}s. • Stacks up to {MaxStacks} times. • At maximum stacks, you may activate All-Kill.
Summon a pack of {MaxStacks} Spirit Wolves above Targets. • Targets all Heroes damaged by your abilities in the last {StackDuration}s. • Deals {Damage}()Damage per Spirit Wolf.
abilities.menuDescription: Passive: Shinbi applies a Mark to Enemy Heroes that she damages with her abilities, lasting for 6s. Additionally, each time Shinbi damages a Hero with an ability she gains a stack of Track for 6s, stacking up to 8 times. Upon reaching maximum Track stacks, Shinbi can activate this ability. Active: Shinbi summons a pack of 8 Spirit Wolves above each currently Marked Enemy Hero. The pack attacks their target, dealing 44/66/88 (+15%) magical damage per Spirit Wolf.
abilities.name: All-Kill!

abilities.desc: Hypercharge Starfire to instead project a beam that deals massive single target damage.
abilities.gameDescription: Hypercharge Starfire. • Lasts {Duration}s and Refreshes on Takedown. • Deals {Damage}()Damage per hit. • Ignores {Pen}% Bonus Physical Armor. • Applies On-Hit Effects at {OnHitModifier}% effectiveness. • Increases its damage by {DamageRamp}% for {Time}s on hit. Max: {MaxRamp}%. Passive: Basic Attacks deal {PassiveDamage}()Damage On-Hit.
abilities.menuDescription: Skylar hypercharges Starfire for 5s (refreshes on Hero Takedown): Convert bonus attack speed into on-hit physical damage and attack at a fixed rate of 10 attacks per second while also ignoring 20% of your Target's Bonus Physical Armor. Starfire's damage is modified to 1/2.5/4/5.5/7 (+10%)(+4%)(+10%) per instance and it applies on-hit effects at 10% effectiveness. Damaging Enemy Units with Hypercharge increases its damage by 1% for 1s, stacking up to 25 times. Passive: Basic Attacks deal 4/8/12/16/20 (+10% ) bonus physical damage on-hit.
abilities.name: Hypercharge

abilities.desc: Ignite the battlefield with Starfire's celestial fury.
abilities.gameDescription: Ranged Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.menuDescription: Ranged basic attack dealing 54/55.79/57.67/59.64/61.71/63.88/66.14/68.5/70.96/73.51/76.15/78.89/81.73/84.66/87.69/90.82/94.04/97.35 (+70%) physical damage.
abilities.name: Starfire

abilities.desc: Jump higher and cause explosions on killing enemies.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Upon killing an Enemy Unit:</>
• Form an orb that explodes after <EffectText>0.75s</>.
• Deals <AttackDamageText>{Damage} Damage</>.
• Orbs from Heroes have triple <AttackDamageText>Damage</> and <EffectText>Radius</>.

• Gain additional Jump Height.
abilities.menuDescription:
Skylar gains additional Jump Height.

Killing an Enemy Unit makes it explode after 0.75s, dealing 30 (+5 per level) physical damage to nearby targets.

Explosions from Enemy Heroes are 3x larger and deal 3x more damage.
abilities.name: Dissonance

abilities.desc: Launch a sticky grenade that detonates, slowing and damaging enemies.
abilities.gameDescription: Launch a bouncing nano bubble: • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attaches to the first Target hit for {Delay}s. After the duration: • Deals {ExplosionDamage}()Damage to nearby Enemies. • Slows them by {Slow}% for {SlowDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Launch a bouncing nano bubble that attaches to the first target hit for 0.75s and deals 20/30/40/50/60 (+20% ) physical damage. After the duration, the target and nearby enemies take 70/100/130/160/190 (+145%)(+80%) physical damage and are Slowed by 40/45/50/55/60% for 1s.
abilities.name: Plasma Grenade

abilities.desc: Launch yourself upwards to fly and launch missiles at targets you damage.
abilities.gameDescription: Thrust upwards after a short delay. • Hover for {HoverDuration}s. • Gain +{Range} Basic Attack Range. Whilst Hovering, dealing damage will fire a missile: • Deals {Damage}()Damage to the same Target. • Can only occur intermittently with Hypercharge.
abilities.menuDescription: Skylar thrusts upwards in her current movement direction, gaining the ability to hover for 3.75s. During this time, Skylar's basic attack range is increased by +100. Dealing damage while hovering also fires a missile that deals 10/15/20/25/30 (+20%)(+12%) physical damage to the same target. This can only occur intermittently with Hypercharge but the time decreases with bonus attack speed.
abilities.name: Air Assault

abilities.desc: Charge and unleash a nuclear projectile that deals massive damage at long range.
abilities.gameDescription: Unleash the Atomiser. • Travels until colliding with Terrain or an Enemy Hero. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Deals an extra {MissingHealthDamage}% Missing Health Damage.
abilities.menuDescription: Channel for a short period of time before firing a large orb of unstable energy. The orb stops on the first hero hit, exploding, dealing 200/330/460 (+150%)(+90%)(+20/25/30% of target’s missing health) physical damage.
abilities.name: Atomiser

abilities.desc: Charge a long range terrain piercing arrow that deals damage to all enemies in its path.
abilities.gameDescription: Charge a powerful piercing arrow. • Reaches maximum power after {MaxChargeTime}s. • Deals up to {Damage}()Damage. • Damage increases by {IncreasedPercent}% per Relentless stack. • Deals {SecondaryPercent}% Damage to Targets beyond the first. • Pierces through all Units and Terrain.
abilities.menuDescription: Charge a Terrain piercing arrow, reaching 50-100% maximum power after 1s and dealing up to 80/115/150/185/220 (+140/148/156/164/172%) physical damage to all Enemies in its path. Targets afflicted by Relentless receive 8% additional damage per stack and Targets beyond the first take 60% damage.
abilities.name: Piercing Shot

abilities.desc: Fire precision arrows at your enemies with your bow, Heartpiercer.
abilities.gameDescription: Ranged Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.name: Heartpiercer

abilities.desc: Dealing damage applies stacks of Relentless to enemy targets. Deal additional damage to enemies with Relentless stacks.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>On successful Ability hits and Basic Attacks:</>
• Apply a stack of <EffectText>Relentless</> to Targets for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>.
• For each stack, deal <HealthText>{HealthPercent}% Target's Maximum Health</> as <AttackDamageText>Damage</> <EffectText>On-Hit</>. 
• Max Stacks per Target: <EffectText>{NumStacks}</>.
abilities.menuDescription:
Sparrow's Basic Attacks and Abilities apply stacks of Relentless to Enemy Units. 

Her Basic Attacks against Targets afflicted by Relentless deal an additional 0.25% of their maximum health as bonus physical damage On-Hit, per stack.

Relentless stacks last for 3s, stacking up to 8 times.
abilities.name: Relentless

abilities.desc: Release a storm of arrows that rain down, dealing damage and slowing all enemies in the area.
abilities.gameDescription: Release a volley of arrows raining down over {Duration}s. • Deal {Damage}()Damage over {NumHits} hits. • Slows by {SlowPercent}%() for {SlowDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Release a volley of arrows that rain down over 2.5s, dealing 100/130/160/190/220 (+100%)(+80%) physical damage to all Enemies in the area over 8 hits. Enemies struck by Hail Of Arrows are Slowed by 35/37.5/40/42.5/45% (+5%) for 0.5s.
abilities.name: Hail of Arrows

abilities.desc: Vanish from view, becoming Stealthed temporarily. Upon reappearing, become empowered, gaining attack speed and enhancing every second basic attack against the same target to deal increased damage.
abilities.gameDescription: Vanish temporarily and become empowered. • Enter Stealth and gains {MovementSpeed}%() Movement Speed for {StealthDuration}s. • Gain {Percent}% Attack Speed for {Duration}s. • Every 2nd Basic Attack against a Target deals {Damage}()Bonus Damage. • This Bonus Damage applies a stack of Relentless.
abilities.menuDescription: Sparrow vanishes from the battlefield, entering Stealth and gaining 30 (+15%) Movement Speed for 1.5s. Upon, reappearing, she gains 25/30/35/40/45% Attack Speed for 6s. Every second subsequent basics attack against the same target while Heightened Senses is active deals (+15%) bonus physical damage and applies an additional stack of Relentless.
abilities.name: Heightened Senses

abilities.desc: Invoke your blazing spirit, augmenting Heartpiercer to release a fan of piercing arrows over a short duration.
abilities.gameDescription: Unleash a barrage of arrows. • Fires {MaxShots} volleys over {Duration}s. • Center arrows deal {Damage}() Damage. • Side arrows deal {SideDamage}() Damage. • Arrows Pierce through Units. • Arrows apply On-Hit Effects at {OnHitModifier}% efficiency. • Arrows can Critically Strike.
abilities.menuDescription: Unleash a barrage of fanned arrows, firing 12/14/16 volleys over 3.5s. The center arrow deals (+75%)(+40%) physical damage. Side arrows deal (+58%)(+30%) damage instead. Inner Fire's arrows pierce Enemy Units, can Critically Strike and apply On-Hit effects at 30% effectiveness.
abilities.name: Inner Fire

abilities.desc: Swipe forward dealing damage and stunning all enemies in front of you.
abilities.gameDescription: Bash forward with your shield. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Deals an extra {HealthPercent}% Maximum Health Damage. • Stuns for {StunDuration}s. • Deals {MonsterDamage} additional Damage to Monsters.
abilities.menuDescription: Swipe forward with Steel's shield, dealing 35/65/95/125/155 (+50%) (+5/5.75/6.5/7.25/8% of the Target's maximum health) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him and Stunning them for 0.5s. Deals 50/55/60/65/70 additional damage to Monsters.
abilities.name: Shield Bash

abilities.desc: Beat your opponents to a pulp with your heavy hitting fists.
abilities.gameDescription: Melee Basic Attack Chain. • Alternate between Light and Heavy Attacks. • Light Attacks deal {Damage}()Damage. • Heavy Attacks deal {HeavyDamage}()Damage.
abilities.menuDescription: Alternate between Light and Heavy Melee basic attacks. Light Attacks deal 25 (+36%) physical damage. Heavy Attacks deal 69 (+100%) physical damage.
abilities.name: Punch

abilities.desc: Shield yourself after remaining out of combat for a duration and gain increased defences.
abilities.gameDescription: On not taking damage for {ShieldRefreshTime}s: • Gain a {ShieldScaling}()Shield. • The Shield lasts until destroyed. Hybrid Defence: • Gain {PhysicalArmor} Physical Armor (Scales with Bonus Magical Armor). • Gain {MagicalArmor} Magical Armor (Scales with Bonus Physical Armor).
abilities.menuDescription:
Steel passively shields himself for 7% of his maximum health.

The shield lasts until destroyed and refreshes if Steel has not taken damage in the last 10/10/10/10/10/9/9/9/9/9/8/8/8/8/8/7/7/7s.

Additionally Steel gains (+10% bonus Magical Armor) Physical Armor and (+10% bonus Physical Armor) Magical armor.
abilities.name: Cybernetic Shell

abilities.desc: Charge forward, dealing damage and sending enemies flying.
abilities.gameDescription: Charge forward in a line. • Become Unstoppable for the dash duration. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Stuns for 2s and Knocks Back Heroes.
abilities.menuDescription: Steel charges forward, becoming Unstoppable for the duration of the dash and dealing 85/125/165/205/245 (+5% )(+70%) magical damage to all Enemies in his path. Enemy Heroes struck by Bull Rush are Knocked Back. Monsters and Minions are Stunned for 2s.
abilities.name: Bull Rush

abilities.desc: Deploy a disruptive wall of energy, blocking all incoming Enemy Projectiles.
abilities.gameDescription: Deploy a disruptive wall of energy. • Destroys Enemy projectiles for {Duration}s. • Deals {Damage}()Damage to Heroes. • Slows by {SlowPercent}% for {SlowDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Deploy a disruptive wall of energy, blocking all incoming Enemy Projectiles for 4s. When an Enemy Hero first passes through the wall, they take 50/75/100/125/150 (+30%) magical damage and are Slowed by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.75s.
abilities.name: Force Shield

abilities.desc: Leap into the sky and crash down at the target location to deal damage and knock up enemies.
abilities.gameDescription: Leap into a powerful impact. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Knocks Up and Stuns for {StunDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Leap into the sky, crashing down at the target location to deal 200/320/440 (+90%) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Knocking them Up and Stunning them for 1.5s.
abilities.name: Shield Slam

abilities.desc:
Become Unstoppable before dashing forward, damaging and stunning the target hit.

Empowered: Gain a shield after hitting an enemy.
abilities.gameDescription: Charge up and Dash forward: • Channel to increase Range and Damage, over {MaxCharge}s. • You are Unstoppable while Channeling. • Deals {Damage}-{MaxDamage}()Damage, based on charge time. • Knocks Back and Stuns for {Stun}s on impact. • Colliding with an Enemy Hero stops the Dash. • Times out and refunds {CooldownRefund}% Cooldown after {MaxDuration}s. Empowered: Shields for {Shield}() for {ShieldDuration}s on Enemy Hit.
abilities.menuDescription: Terra becomes Unstoppable and Channels for up to 3.5s before dashing. She deals 27/48/69/90/111 (+40%) (+40%) physical damage to all Enemies in her path, stopping if she collides with a Hero. Enemies hit are Knocked Back for 0.25s. For the first 1.25s, dash range and damage increases, dealing up to 81/144/207/270/333 (+120%) (+120%) physical damage. Empowered: On Enemy hit, gain a 5/65/125/185/245 (+10/12/14/16/18% ) shield for 3.5s.
abilities.name: Wild Rush

abilities.desc: Cleave through your enemies with your battleaxe, Skullsplitter.
abilities.gameDescription: Melee Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.name: Skullsplitter

abilities.desc:
Gain bonus Armors while under Towers, and generate stacks when damaging Enemies.

At maximum stacks, Terra's next Basic Ability is Empowered with additional effects.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Damage Enemies to gain Stacks of Hersir</>:
• <EffectText>Skullsplitter</> grants 1 stack on-hit.
• <EffectText>Ruthless Assault</> can grant 1 stack per strike.
• <EffectText>Highland Hurl</> & <EffectText>Wild Rush</> can grant 1 stack per cast.
• Enter the <EffectText>Base</> to gain 5 stacks.
• <AbilityName>At 5 Stacks</>: Your next <EffectText>Basic Ability</> becomes <AbilityName>Empowered</>.

<EffectText>Passive</>: While under a <EffectText>Tower</>, gain <EffectText>+{BonusArmors}% Armors</> for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>.
abilities.menuDescription:
Terra gains stacks of Hersir when damaging Enemies with her Basic Attacks and Abilities, up to a maximum of 5. At maximum stacks, Terra's next Basic Ability is Empowered with additional effects. 

Entering the Base grants Terra maximum Hersir stacks instantly.

Terra also gains 10% increased Armors while under a Tower.
abilities.name: Hersir

abilities.desc:
Spin your axe, striking all Enemies around you twice.

Empowered: Strike three times instead.
abilities.gameDescription: Spin your axe around you, striking twice: • Deals {Damage}()Damage each strike. • Hitting Heroes refunds {CooldownRefund}% Cooldown per strike. Empowered: Strike three times. • Third strike deals (+{MaxHealthDamage}% Target's Max Health) bonus Damage.
abilities.menuDescription: Terra spins her axe, striking all Enemies around her before slashing forward a second time. Each strike deals 50/80/110/140/170 (+35%)(+35%) physical damage. Enemy Hero hits refund 10% of the cooldown per strike. Empowered: Terra strikes three times, with the third strike dealing an additional (+5/6.25/7.5/8.75/10 Target's Max Health)% damage to all Enemies in front of her.
abilities.name: Ruthless Assault

abilities.desc:
Throw a spectral axe, dealing damage. Enemies hit are slowed and have their Physical Armor reduced.

Empowered: Roots enemies hit for a duration.
abilities.gameDescription: Throw a spectral axe: • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Shreds Enemy Physical Armor by {Shred}% for {ShredDuration}s. • Slows Enemies by {Slow}% for {SlowDuration}s. • Pierces Enemy Units. Empowered: Roots Enemies instead for {RootDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Throw a spectral axe, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+40%)(+40%) physical damage to all Enemies in its path. Enemies hit by Highland Hurl are Slowed by 40% for 1.25s. and have their Physical Armor reduced by 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% for 4.5s. Empowered: Roots Enemies instead for 1.25s.
abilities.name: Highland Hurl

abilities.desc: Slam your helmet down, cleansing all debuffs, disabling nearby Enemy Towers and gain max Hersir stacks instantly. Additionally, you becomes buffed for a short duration.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Slam down your helmet</>:
• <EffectText>Cleanse</> any <CC_Text>Debuffs</> and gain Max <EffectText>Hersir</> stacks.
• <CC_Text>Slow</> nearby Enemies by <CC_Text>{Slow}%</>, decaying over <CC_Text>{SlowDuration}s</>.

<CC_Text>Disable</> nearby <CC_Text>Enemy Towers</> for <CC_Text>{DisableDuration}s</> and become <GoldText>Buffed</> for <GoldText>{Duration}s</>:    
• Gain <AttackDamageText>+{BonusPhysicalArmor} Physical Armor</>, <AbilityPowerText>+{BonusMagicalArmor} Magical Armor</>, and <EffectText>+{Tenacity} Tenacity</>. 

<EffectText>Passive:</> Gain <AttackDamageText>{PhysicalArmor} Physical Armor</> and <AbilityPowerText>{MagicalArmor} Magical Armor</>.
abilities.menuDescription:
Terra’s helmet slams down, Cleansing all debuffs and disabling Enemy Towers within 1650u for 4/4.5/5s. When this occurs, she instantly gains maximum Hersir stacks and Slows all nearby Enemy Units by 60%, decaying over 2s.

For the next 8/9/10s, Terra gains 16/30/44 Physical Armor, 16/30/44 Magical Armor and 50/100/150 Tenacity.

Passive: Gain 6/9/12 Physical Armor and 6/9/12 Magical Armor.
abilities.name: Unstoppable Force

abilities.desc: Hurl a small plant that deals damage over time then explodes for even more damage.
abilities.gameDescription: Hurl a plant that creates a patch of spores. • Deals {Damage}()Damage over 2s. • Then explodes, dealing {Damage}()Damage.
abilities.menuDescription: Hurl a small plant that deals 100/150/200/250/300 (+100%) magical damage over time to all Enemies in the area, exploding after 2s. Untamed Growth deals 50% of its damage over its lifetime, and 50% upon exploding.
abilities.name: Untamed Growth

abilities.desc: Fire ferocious flowers at your prey.
abilities.gameDescription: Ranged Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.menuDescription: Ranged basic attack dealing 55/57.35/59.82/62.41/65.13/67.98/70.95/74.05/77.28/80.63/84.1/87.7/91.43/95.28/99.26/103.37/107.6/111.95 (+55%) physical damage.
abilities.name: Floret

abilities.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, spawn an Untamed Growth on their corpse.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>On Takedown:</>
• Spawn an <AbilityName>Untamed Growth</> from the Hero's corpse.
• Gain <EffectText>{SpeedPercent}% Movement Speed</> for <EffectText>{RegenerateDuration}s</>.
abilities.menuDescription: Each time The Fey achieves a Takedown she spawns an Untamed Growth from the Enemy Hero's corpse and gains 30% movement speed for 3s.
abilities.name: Nature's Vengeance

abilities.desc: Summon a patch of thorny brambles, dealing damage and slowing enemies whilst speeding up allies.
abilities.gameDescription: Summon a patch of thorny brambles. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Enemies touched are Slowed by {Slow}% for {SlowDuration}s. • Grants Allies {MSBuff}% Movement Speed for {SlowDuration}s. • Persists for {Duration}s before wilting.

abilities.name: Bramble Patch

abilities.desc: Throw an orb of nature energy, dealing heavy damage.
abilities.gameDescription: Throw an orb of energy. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Hit the same Target within {StackDuration}s for a bonus. • Deals {StackDamageIncrease}% more Damage. (Stacks up to 4 times.) • Refunds 40% Mana on hitting a Hero or Killing a Unit.
abilities.menuDescription: Throw an orb of energy, dealing 80/115/150/185/220 (+55%) magical damage. Hitting the same Target within 8s deals 20% increased damage, stacking up to 4 times. Harvest Nettles refunds 75% of its mana cost upon hitting an Enemy Hero or Killing a Unit.
abilities.name: Harvest Nettles

abilities.desc: Plant a magical seedling, awakening a giant fly trap that attaches itself to all nearby enemy heroes. After a brief delay, it Pulls its victims inward, dealing damage and stunning.
abilities.gameDescription: Awaken a giant fly trap. • Attaches itself to nearby Heroes. • After a delay it Pulls attached Heroes inward. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Stuns for {StunDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Plant a magical seedling, awakening a giant fly trap that attaches itself to all nearby Enemy Heroes. After a brief delay, it Pulls its victims inward, dealing 250/375/500 (+100%) magical damage and Stunning them for 1s.
abilities.name: Fly Trap

abilities.desc: Launch a grenade that explodes upon contact with an enemy, dealing damage and slowing.
abilities.gameDescription: Launch a bouncing grenade. • Explodes on contact with an Enemy. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Slows by {Slow}% for {SlowDuration}s. • Holds up to 2 grenades.
abilities.menuDescription: Launch a grenade in target direction that explodes upon contact with an Enemy Target, dealing 35/60/85/110/135 (+45%) magical damage in a small area and Slowing by 30% for 0.75s. Max Charges: 2
abilities.name: Vortex Grenade

abilities.desc: Fire a cartrige of superheated plasma from each of the LUNARI 4.0s.
abilities.gameDescription: Ranged Basic Attack. • Fires twice. • Each deals {Damage}()Damage. • Applies On-Hit Effects at {OnHitModifier}% effectiveness. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.menuDescription: Ranged basic attack that fires two projectiles, each dealing 33 (+42.5%) physical damage and applying on-hit effects at 55% effectiveness.
abilities.name: LUNARI 4.0

abilities.desc: Casting an ability will cause your next basic attack to fire three times.
abilities.gameDescription: On casting an Ability: • Your next Basic Attack fires 3 times. • They deal a total of {Damage}()Damage. • Each shot applies On-Hit Effects at {OnHitModifier}% effectiveness. • Increases Attack Speed by {AttackSpeed}%. • Lasts for {Duration}s
abilities.menuDescription: Casting an ability grants TwinBlast 20% increased Total Attack Speed and will cause his next basic attack within 4s to fire three times for a total of 142.5% damage, with each shot applying on-hit effects at 60% effectiveness.
abilities.name: Gunslinger

abilities.desc: Charge and fire two superheated piercing projectiles, each dealing damage.
abilities.gameDescription: Fire two piercing projectiles. • Deals a total of {Damage}()Damage. • Applies On-Hit Effects at a total of {OnHitModifier}% effectiveness.
abilities.menuDescription: TwinBlast charges and fires two superheated piercing projectiles in the target direction, dealing a total of 100/140/180/220/260 (+95%)(+120%) physical damage and applying on-hit effects to all Enemy Units hit at 200% effectiveness.
abilities.name: Vaporize

abilities.desc: Roll or dash in the direction of movement depending on if you're in the air.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Use your thrusters to boost in a direction.</>
• Damaging a Hero reduces the <EffectText>Cooldown</> by <EffectText>{CooldownReduction}%</>.
• Reduced to <EffectText>{NonHeroCDR}%</> when damaging Non-Heroes.
abilities.menuDescription:
Passive: When TwinBlast deals damage to an Enemy Hero with a Basic Attack or Ability, Rocket Dash's cooldown is decreased by 8/9/10/11/12%. Reduced to 3.2/3.6/4/4.4/4.8% when damaging Non-Heroes.

Active: TwinBlast dashes in his current movement direction.
abilities.name: Rocket Dash

abilities.desc: Set the LUNARI 4.0s to full auto, unleashing a barrage of bullets over three seconds that deals a massive amount of damage.
abilities.gameDescription: Transform your pistols into machine guns. • Unleashes a barrage of {NumBullets}()bullets over 3s. • Deals a total of {Damage}()Damage. • Can Critically Strike at {Crit}% effectiveness.
abilities.menuDescription: Transform your guns into fully automatic machine guns, unleashing a barrage of 30 (+10% Total Attack Speed) bullets over 3s dealing 15/20/25 (+9%)(+9%) physical damage per bullet. Can Critically Strike at 75% effectiveness.
abilities.name: Ventilate

abilities.desc: Bind an unfortunate Soul to you, dealing damage over time whilst slowing and grounding them. Steal attack speed from them whilst tethered.
abilities.gameDescription: Use your blood to bind an unfortunate Soul. • Deals {Damage}()Damage over {Duration}s. • Grounds and Slows them by {Slow}% for {Duration}s. • Steal {AttackSpeed}% Attack Speed from the Enemy. • Crowd Control, Line of Sight or Distance can destroy the bind.
abilities.menuDescription: Valmont uses his blood to bind an Enemy to him, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+60%) magical damage over 3s. When binding an Enemy, they are grounded and slowed by 25% for 3s. Valmont steals 10/15/20/25/30% attack speed from the bound Enemy. If Valmont is affected by Crowd Control or the Enemy cuts line of sight or gets far enough away from Valmont, the bind is broken.
abilities.name: Arterial Grip

abilities.desc: Torture your enemies by firing powerful blood strikes.
abilities.gameDescription: Ranged Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.menuDescription: Ranged basic attack dealing 49/51.8/54.75/57.85/61.1/64.5/68.05/71.75/75.6/79.6/83.75/88.05/92.5/97.1/101.85/106.75/111.8/117 (+60%) physical damage.
abilities.name: Crimson Sigil

abilities.desc: Lilith hunts her prey, striking Enemies damaged by you. Regenerate Mana by consuming souls of Enemies taken down. Restoration is increased on Hero Deaths.
abilities.gameDescription: Lilith hunts and consumes the souls of fallen Enemies. • Lilith strikes Enemies damaged by Crimson Sigil or Bloodbound. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attack Speed decreases time between Strikes. • Restore {Mana} Mana on Enemy Takedown. • Restore {ManaHero}% Max. Mana instead on Enemy Hero Takedown.
abilities.menuDescription: When Valmont deals damage to an Enemy with Crimson Sigil or Bloodbound causes Lilith to strike them, dealing 12/20/28/36/44/23/31/39/47 (Based on Bloodbound Level) (+15%) magical damage. The more attack speed Valmont has, the shorter the delay between strikes is. On Enemy Takedown their soul is consumed by Lilith and you restore 3/3/4/4/5/6/8/10/12/14/17/20/23/26/29/32/35/38-41 Mana (Based on Hero Level). Consuming the soul of an Enemy Hero restores 35% Maximum Mana additionally.
abilities.name: Hemophagia

abilities.desc: Manifest replicas of your Blade. After a short delay, they sequentially launch forward, dealing damage in a small area.
abilities.gameDescription: Manifest {ProjCount} blood-forged blades. • Blade sequentially launch forward over {CastTime}s. • Deal {Damage}()Damage per Blade in a small area.
abilities.menuDescription: Valmont manifests 5 blood-forged blades above his head. Over the next 0.75s, these blades sequentially launch forward. Each Blade detonates upon impact, dealing 20/28/36/44/52 (+15%) magical damage in a small area.
abilities.name: Rupture

abilities.desc: Actively target Lilith dealing Damage to Enemies in an area whilst gaining Attack Speed. Whenever Bloodbound is leveled, the Damage of Hemophagias is increased.
abilities.gameDescription: Command Lilith to slice a targeted area. • Deals {ThrowDamage}()Damage. • Grants {AttackSpeed}% Attack Speed when dealing Damage. • Liliths Strikes of Hemophagia deal an additional {TickDamage} Damage based on Bloodbounds Level.
abilities.menuDescription: Active: Valmont launches Lilith, dealing 70/90/110/130/150 (+60%) magical damage. Damaging an Enemy grants 20/25/30/35/40% attack speed for 4s. Increasing the level of Bloodbound increases the strike damage of Hemophagia by 8 magical damage.
abilities.name: Bloodbound

abilities.desc: Unleash terrifying swarms of bats that deal magical damage when hitting enemies. The Bats then return and heal Valmont.
abilities.gameDescription: Drain the life of your Enemies. • Toggle: Fire up to {ProjectileCount} swarms of bats, dealing {Damage}()Damage each. • Bats return to Valmont restoring {Heal}()Health. • Healing reduced to {HealingModifier}% against Minions and Monsters. • Every second Exsanguinate is active, the Mana Cost increases by {Mana}.
abilities.menuDescription: Unleash up to 3 swarms of bats, dealing 40/65/90 (+23%) magical damage. Upon hitting the Enemy, bats return to Valmont, restoring 2/4/6 (+2.2%) health. When hitting Heroes 10x the amount of health is restored instead. Exsanguinate costs 5 Mana more for every Second it is active.
abilities.name: Exsanguinate

abilities.desc: Fire a sniper shot that deals high damage. If this ability hits a marked target, deal extra damage and reduce the cooldown.
abilities.gameDescription: Fire a long-range sniper shot: • Deals {Damage}() Damage. • Deals {BonusDamage}% Bonus Damage to Minions. • Benefits from Lifesteals. If this Kills, or Damages a Marked Unit: • Refund {ManaRefund}% Mana Cost and reduce the Cooldown by {CDROnKill}%.
abilities.menuDescription: Fire a long-range sniper shot that deals 20/35/50/65/80 (+110%)(+70%) physical damage to the first Enemy Unit hit. Damage is increased by 100% against Enemy Minions. Knock, Knock! benefits from lifesteal. If Knock, Knock! Kills, or Damages a marked Unit, 35% of the Mana Cost is refunded and its Cooldown is decreased by 75%.
abilities.name: Knock, Knock!

abilities.desc: Snipe your enemies with pinpoint precision with The Neutralizer.
abilities.gameDescription: Ranged Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}() Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.menuDescription: Ranged basic attack dealing 57/59.24/61.6/64.08/66.68/69.4/72.24/75.2/78.28/81.48/84.8/88.24/91.8/95.48/99.28/103.2/107.24/111.4 (+90%) (+20%) physical damage.
abilities.name: The Neutralizer

abilities.desc: Your Vision Item becomes a Sonar Drone that when launched will scan the surrounding area,
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header> Wraith is granted a Sonar Drone that:</>
• Replaces your <EffectText>Vision Item</>.
• Cannot be swapped.

When Sonar Drone is deployed it:
• Becomes <EffectText>Camouflaged</>.
• Reveals Enemies within a <EffectText>1000u</> radius.
abilities.menuDescription:
Wraith's Vision Item becomes a Sonar Drone that will become Camouflaged upon deployment, revealing Enemies within 1000 units. 

Sonar Drone can detect Enemy Heroes through walls.
abilities.name: Who's There?

abilities.desc: Launch a piercing Nanite Grenade that deals damage, slows, and marks everything hit.
abilities.gameDescription: Launch a piercing Nanite Grenade. • Deals {Damage}() Damage. • Slows by {Slow}% for {SlowDuration}s. • Units hit are Marked for {MarkDuration}s, Revealing them. Knock, Knock! is enhanced against Marked Units: • Deals an extra {BonusDamage}()% Maximum Health Damage.
abilities.menuDescription: Launch a piercing Nanite Grenade that deals 40/60/80/100/120 (+60%)(+50%) physical damage to all Units hit, Slowing them by 35% for 1.25s. Units hit are also Marked for 3.5s, Revealing them. Knock, Knock! is enhanced against Marked Units, dealing an extra 5.5/6/6.5/7/7.5% (+1.5% per 100 Magical Power) of their maximum health as bonus magical damage.
abilities.name: Peekaboo!

abilities.desc: Enter Camouflage and gain movement speed. Takedowns will reset the cooldown of Surprise.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>After a short delay:</>
• Enter <EffectText>Camouflage</>.
• Gain <EffectText>{MoveSpeed}% Movement Speed</> for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>. 
• Gain <EffectText>1 Enhanced Jump</>.
• <EffectText>Cooldown</> resets on <EffectText>Takedown</>.

<EffectText>Passive: </>Gain <PenDamageText>{PhysicalPenetrationPercent}% Physical Penetration</>.
abilities.menuDescription:
After a short delay, enter Camouflage and gain 25% movement speed and one enhanced Jump for 3s.

Takedowns will reset the cooldown of Surprise, Surprise!

Passive: Gain 10/14/18/22/26% Physical Penetration
abilities.name: Surprise, Surprise!

abilities.desc: Choose a nearby enemy hero and mark their location from 2s prior. After a delay they will teleport back to this location.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Teleport a Hero to a previous location:</> 
• Heroes can be selected up to <EffectText>{Range}</> units away.
• Marks their location from <EffectText>2.5s</> prior. 
• After <EffectText>1.5s</> they enter <EffectText>Limbo</> and <EffectText>Teleport</> back.
• After <EffectText>Teleporting</>, they are <EffectText>Marked</> for <EffectText>{MarkDuration}s</>.
abilities.menuDescription: Wraith can choose an Enemy Hero he can see up to 1550/1650/1750 units, marking their location from 2s prior. After a 1.5s delay they will enter Limbo and Teleport back to this location.
abilities.name: Back It Up!

abilities.desc:
Spirit: Dash forward with the wind, dealing damage.
Body: Force your enemies and clones away and deal damage.
abilities.menuDescription: Spirit: Wukong dashes forward dealing 60/85/110/135/160/185 (+100%) damage and Slowing everything hit by 40% for 0.5s. Body: Wukong enlarges his staff sending it forward dealing 60/85/110/135/160/185 (+100%) damage, Slowing for 30% for 0.75s and forcing away all enemies and Clones.
abilities.name: Windsurge/Force Push

abilities.desc: Beat your opponents senseless with the iconic Gold-Banded Staff.
abilities.gameDescription: Melee Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.name: Ruyi Jingu Bang

abilities.desc: Wukong can jump an additional time.
abilities.gameDescription: Jumping while mid-air will allow you to leap into the air.
abilities.menuDescription: Double Jump to leap into the air.
abilities.name: Somersault

abilities.desc:
Spirit: Create walkable clouds beneath you.
Body: Leap in a direction and gain Attack Speed.
abilities.menuDescription: Spirit: Wukong gains 6/7/8/9/10/11% movement speed and creates a trail of cloud, walkable by allies for 4s. Body: Wukong leaps in the current movement direction gaining 20/24/28/32/36/40% (+60%) Attack Speed for 4s.
abilities.name: Cloudwalker/Pole Vault

abilities.desc:
Spirit: Gain Damage Reduction and Stun Enemies.
Body: Slam down dealing more damage based on height.
abilities.menuDescription: Spirit: Wukong spins his staff around himself gaining 25% (+50%) Damage Reduction for the duration. Afterwards he throws the staff forward dealing 60/80/100/120/140/160 (+70%) damage and Stunning for 0.8s. Body: Wukong enlarges his staff and slams down to the ground dealing 60/100/140/180/220/260 (+135%) damage and slowing by 40% for 0.75. This damage is increased by drop distance up to 1500 units. Minions receive 70% less damage.
abilities.name: Cyclebreaker/High Impact

abilities.desc: Switch between Body and Spirit Stances, changing your basic abilities.
abilities.gameDescription:
Wukong switches between his Spirit and Body Stances.
Upon damaging Enemies: • Gain a stack of Hair, up to 5. • At 5 stacks, remove them to spawn a Clone. • Clones have {Health}() Health and deal {Damage}()Damage per hit. • You may have up to {Amount} Clones at a time.
abilities.menuDescription: Switch between Body and Spirit Stances Upon damaging Enemies 5 times, a hair leaps from Wukong and lands, spawning a Clone. Clones deal (+12%) physical damage per hit and have 16%() Health. Wukong may have up to 2/3/4/5 clones at one time.
abilities.name: 84000 Hairs

abilities.desc: Master the art of deflection by redirecting enemy projectiles and dealing damage to nearby enemies that pushes them back.
abilities.gameDescription: Crack your whip forming a sphere of pressure. • Deals {Damage}()Physical Damage instantly. • Pushback Targets hit. • Reflects Enemy projectiles for the next {Duration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Yin cracks her whip, Pushing away nearby Enemies. Deals 20/40/60/80/100 (+100%)(+60%) physical damage and creates a sphere of pressure around her for 0.8s. If Enemy projectiles hit the sphere, they are reflected toward the target location.
abilities.name: Backlash

abilities.desc: Your whip sings through the air, a graceful extension of your will, striking with honed precision.
abilities.gameDescription: Melee Basic Attack: • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.menuDescription: Melee basic attack dealing 60/61.75/63.59/65.53/67.56/69.69/71.91/74.22/76.63/79.13/81.72/84.41/87.19/90.06/93.03/96.09/99.25/102.5 (+75%) physical damage.
abilities.name: Silksong

abilities.desc: Dealing damage builds up stacking attack speed. Go too long without dealing damage and this effect ends.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Basic Attacks against Heroes or Monsters grant Stacks:</>  
• Stacks up to <EffectText>{MaxStacks}</> times and lasts <EffectText>{Duration}s</>.
• Each Stack grants <EffectText>{AttackSpeed}% Total Attack Speed</>.  
• Damaging Enemies with <AbilityName>Lash Kick</> grants <EffectText>{Stacks}</> Stacks.
abilities.menuDescription:
Yin’s basic attacks against Heroes or Monsters grant her a stack of Rising Storm per Target hit for 3s, stacking up to 6 times, with the duration refreshing on subsequent attacks. 

Each stack grants 3/4/5/6% Total Attack Speed, for a maximum of 18/24/30/36% Total Attack Speed.
abilities.name: Rising Storm

abilities.desc: With a flick, your whip becomes a tether, propelling you towards an enemy target or terrain.
abilities.gameDescription: Swing your whip and attach it to Target location. • Upon hitting an Enemy or Terrain, Dash to the location. • Upon arrival, deal {Damage}()Physical Damage. • Slows by {Slow}% for {SlowDuration}s. • Then Leap in current movement direction.
abilities.name: Lash Kick

abilities.desc: Channel the wind's fury, extending your whip's reach and gaining the ability to cleave through multiple enemies with increased force.
abilities.gameDescription:
Passive: Every third successful consecutive Basic Attack deals {PercentDamage}% Maximum Health Damage and restores {Healing}() Health.
Extend your whip. • Increase Attack Range to 1100 units. • Gain {Cleave}% Cleave for {Duration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Passive: Every third successful consecutive basic attack will deal 2/2.5/3/3.5/4% of the target’s maximum health as bonus physical damage and heals Yin for +(10/12/14/16/18%) Health. Active: Yin extends her whip, increasing the range of her basic attack to 1100 units and gaining 30/40/50/60/70% cleave for 6s.
abilities.name: Windburn

abilities.desc: Summon a raging vortex that ensnares and halts enemy projectiles, slows them down and grants you increased movement speed.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Surround yourself in gale winds.</>
• Lasts <EffectText>{Duration}s</>.
• <CC_Text>Slows</> Enemies within by <CC_Text>{SlowPercent}%</>.
• Gain <EffectText>{MoveSpeed}% Movement Speed</> within.
• Enemy projectiles are <EffectText>Halted</>.
abilities.menuDescription:
Yin surrounds herself in gale winds.

For 5s, the winds will apply a 10% Slow to Enemies within and grants Yin 10% movement speed. 
Enemy projectiles that travel through it are halted.
abilities.name: Quelling Gale

abilities.desc: Hurl three exploding Kunai that mark targets for Severance.
abilities.gameDescription: Throw three exploding kunai. • Deal {Damage}()Damage each. • Apply Soul Rip to Heroes and Monsters hit for {Duration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Launch three projectiles that explode, each dealing 30/40/50/60/70 (+35%) damage to targets hit and apply Soul Rip to them for 4s.
abilities.name: Whispering Echoes

abilities.desc: Slice through foes, Body and Spirit.
abilities.gameDescription: Melee Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.
abilities.menuDescription: Melee basic attack dealing 60/62.24/64.6/67.08/69.68/72.4/75.24/78.2/81.28/84.48/87.8/91.24/94.8/98.48/102.28/106.2/110.24/114.4 (+65%) physical damage.
abilities.name: Kokoroken

abilities.desc: After casting an ability, empower your blade for your next two attacks to launch soul wave projectiles that deal bonus damage and bounce between foes.
abilities.gameDescription: Use bouncing kunai after casting an Ability: • Gain {AttackSpeed}% Attack Speed for {Duration}s. • The next 2 Basic Attacks become Ranged. • Deal {Damage}()Bonus Damage. • Bounce twice, dealing {BounceMultiplier}% damage.
abilities.menuDescription: Casting an ability grants you ranged (850u) basic attacks and 30/30/30/30/30/36/36/36/36/36/42/42/42/42/42/48/48/48% attack speed for the next two basic attacks. These attacks deal (+8%) bonus physical damage and bounce 2 times, dealing 15/15/15/15/15/20/20/20/20/20/25/25/25/25/25/30/30/30% damage to targets hit.
abilities.name: Hallowed Strikes

abilities.desc: Perform a spinning kick to unleash souls, damaging, marking nearby enemies and healing you if they are a hero or monster. Casting in-air will cause you to leap upwards.
abilities.gameDescription: Perform a Spinning Soul Kick. • Deal {Damage}()Damage to nearby Enemies. • Apply Soul Rip to Heroes hit for {Duration}s. • Restore {Healing}()Health. • Increased by up to {HealingMultiplier}% based on Missing Health. If cast in-air: • Leap upwards in current movement direction.
abilities.menuDescription: Perform a spinning kick that deals 70/90/110/130/150 (+70%) physical damage to nearby enemies and apply Soul Rip to them for 4s. If cast in-air, you will additionaly leap upwards in your current movement direction. Heal 20/35/50/65/80 (+75%) health, increased by 0-50% based on missing health if an Enemy Hero or Monster is hit.
abilities.name: Anima Burst

abilities.desc: Rush forwards cutting through enemies in your path. If marked, their spirit is seperated, sharing damage dealt to it back to its host.
abilities.gameDescription: Cut the spirits by dashing forwards. • Deal {Damage}()Damage. • Slows Enemies by {Slow}% for {SlowDuration}s. • Cooldown is reset upon consuming Soul Rip. Consumes Soul Rip to spawn a Soul for {Duration}s. • The Soul has {SoulHealth}% of the Enemy's Maximum Health. • Shares Damage with the owner of the Soul.
abilities.menuDescription: Rush forwards, dealing 55/75/95/115/135 (+115%) physical damage to targets hit. Colliding with a target affected by Soul Rip consumes it to reset the cooldown of Severance and tear their Soul from the target for 4s. Souls linger around their hosts with 8% of their maximum health and share any damage dealt to them with their host. Consuming Soul Rip with a Soul still active will refresh its health.
abilities.name: Severance

abilities.desc: Unleash a storm of souls, damaging and slowing nearby enemies before pulling them towards you, tearing their spirits from their body. Then perform a final downwards slash to strike all nearby enemies.
abilities.gameDescription: Summon a Raging Maelstrom for {Duration}s. • Deal {Damage}()Damage over the duration. • Apply Soul Rip to Targets hit for {MarkDuration}s. After the Duration: • Deal {FinalDamage}()Damage and Pull Enemies towards you. • Consume Soul Rip to spawn a Soul of each Target. • Reset the Cooldown of Severance.

At the end of the duration, pull all targets towards you, tear their spirits and strike downwards, dealing 130/215/300 (+80%) physical damage and reset the cooldown of Severence.
abilities.name: Soulstorm

abilities.desc: Channel to throw The Spear of Nyr, dealing damage. Tapping this ability instead instantly stabs with the spear and reduces its cooldown.

Releasing within {Hold}s will Thrust the spear forward: • Thrusts deal {StabDamage}()Damage. • Thrusts refund {CDR}% of the Cooldown.
abilities.menuDescription: Channel to throw a spear, dealing 70/105/140/175/210 (+125%)(+80%) physical damage to Enemies hit, increased by 100% against targets below 20% maximum health. Deals 75% damage to Minions & Monsters. Releasing within 0.2s will thrust the spear forward, dealing 85% damage and refunding 60% of the cooldown.
abilities.name: Spear of Nyr

abilities.desc: Pierce through your enemies with the Nyrian Spear.

abilities.menuDescription: Melee basic attack dealing 62/64.94/68.04/71.29/74.7/78.27/82/85.89/89.93/94.13/98.49/103/107.68/112.51/117.49/122.64/127.94/133.4 (+75%) physical damage.

abilities.desc: Gain a stack of Gladiator when dealing damage. Stacks grant increased power. After exiting combat, stacks will restore health.

abilities.menuDescription: Gain a stack of Gladiator when dealing damage with Basic Attacks or Abilities to Non-Minions, stacking up to 8 times. Each stack grants 1% increased Physical Power. After exiting combat for 5s, stacks will fall off once per second, restoring (+0.3/0.3/0.3/0.3/0.3/0.6/0.6/0.6/0.6/0.6/1.2/1.2/1.2/1.2/1.2/2.4/2.4/2.4%/0.6%/1.2%/2.4% ) Health per stack consumed.
